About the Role

Clay is scaling fast and the IT function is new. The IT Support Team will be the first point of contact for requests, the team that keeps the queue moving, and a key partner to the Head of IT in building out how the helpdesk operates.

The core of the support engineer role is service delivery: triaging incoming requests, resolving issues quickly, and making sure employees get reliable, responsive support. Alongside that, you'll work closely with the Head of IT to configure workflows and build process in our AI-powered ITSM platform, so the function gets more efficient as Clay grows.

This is a good fit if you take pride in running a clean queue, communicate clearly with employees, and are genuinely interested in building better process, not just executing it.

What You’ll Do (Job Responsibilities)

  • Be the face of IT at Clay. Triage and resolve incoming requests across access, software provisioning, onboarding and offboarding, hardware support, and general helpdesk needs. Employees should feel like IT is fast, reliable, and easy to work with.

  • Own onboarding and offboarding execution. Provision and deprovision accounts, coordinate hardware, and make sure new hires are set up from day one and departing employees are fully off-boarded without gaps.

  • Help build the helpdesk function. Partner with the Head of IT to configure and improve our ITSM platform — define request categories, build intake workflows, and manage queues as the function takes shape and scales.

  • Keep the office running. Support conference room AV, networking equipment, peripherals, and general office tech so employees can do their best work without technology getting in the way.

  • Administer the SaaS stack. Manage day-to-day administration across Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and other core tools — provisioning users, managing settings, and keeping things clean.

  • Handle hardware logistics. Coordinate device provisioning, shipping, receiving, and basic asset tracking so employees have what they need when they need it.

  • Build process, not just runbooks. Document what you own, identify patterns in incoming requests, and flag opportunities to improve or automate recurring work. The goal is a helpdesk that gets smarter over time.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3 to 5 years in IT support, helpdesk, or a closely related role

  • Strong service delivery instincts; you prioritize well, keep queues clean, and close requests with clear communication

  • Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms; you understand how to configure and manage one, not just work inside it

  • Broad SaaS admin experience: Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and similar platforms; you've provisioned users, managed settings, and handled admin tasks across a modern SaaS stack

  • Familiarity with office technology: conference room AV setup and troubleshooting, Meraki or similar networking equipment, common peripherals

  • Experience supporting onboarding and offboarding workflows end to end

  • Technical fluency: comfortable in SaaS platforms, macOS, and basic identity and access management tasks (provisioning, deprovisioning, group management)

  • AI-forward mindset: you use AI tools to work faster, handle volume more intelligently, and improve the support experience

  • Process-oriented: you notice what's inefficient and want to fix it

  • Clear communicator: employees trust you and know their issues are being handled

Bonus Points If You

  • Experience with Serval ITSM, either launching it or working within it day to day

  • Experience at a fast-scaling startup where IT processes were being built out

  • Familiarity with Okta or similar identity platforms at a user/admin level

  • Experience building workflows or automations in an ITSM or similar platform

  • Exposure to broader automation tooling

Why This Role

You'll handle the most visible function in IT and have a real hand in shaping how it works. Clay is an AI-forward company and this role reflects that — we're building a helpdesk that runs well and gets smarter over time. Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

Our partners use Deducta to deliver major transformations, and winning them takes a consultative sale with senior executives. This role owns customer acquisition end to end, from opening relationships with C-suite and VP-level leaders to signed partnership. You'll report to the leadership team.

You'll have significant autonomy to lead sophisticated enterprise deals, work directly with client data in our platform, and build the business cases that win them. You'll carry a quota and be accountable for closing new business. As the commercial function grows, you'll be a leader in it, setting the standard for how we sell and shaping the repeatable motion behind it.

What you'll do

  • Customer acquisition: Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and engaging senior executives through to close.

  • Pipeline generation: Map target accounts, open relationships with senior stakeholders and build a pipeline of enterprises where Deducta can deliver outsized value.

  • Business cases: Build quantified business cases and materials that translate Deducta's capabilities into the outcomes decision-makers care about.

  • Complex deals: Lead multi-stakeholder deals, run product demonstrations, work with client data in the platform, and coordinate product, engineering and delivery to keep momentum.

  • Pipeline discipline: Make next steps, risks, decision-makers and deal status explicit across every opportunity.

  • Closing: Carry a quota and close new enterprise business, negotiating commercial terms and guiding deals through procurement and legal to signature.

Success in this role means:

  • Quota attainment: You consistently hit your number by creating and closing high-quality enterprise opportunities where Deducta can deliver meaningful value.

  • Deal momentum: Complex deals move forward with clear next steps, strong executive sponsorship and fewer stalls or surprises.

  • Trusted before signing: Prospects understand the business case for Deducta and see us as a credible partner before they sign.

  • Repeatable motion: You help make the commercial motion more repeatable, and others learn from how you sell.

Who you are

We're looking for a commercially minded, high-agency seller with a proven track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals. You'll combine structured problem solving and analytical depth with the drive to win sophisticated enterprise customers.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Executive presence: You can sit across from a CPO or CFO, earn their trust and build a relationship that lasts beyond the deal.

  • Commercial judgement: You read an account, understand what matters to each stakeholder and find the best path to a decision.

  • Analytical instincts: You work directly with client data and turn the analysis into a clear, compelling business case.

  • Programme management: You coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder processes and follow through without a pre-existing playbook.

  • Product fluency: You run product demonstrations and work in the platform yourself rather than relying on others.

  • Drive to win: You have the hunger to create opportunities, sustain momentum and close business, with a record of hitting or exceeding quota.

  • Nice to have: Entrepreneurial experience, experience mentoring or leading others, or prior startup or high-growth go-to-market experience.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical exercise

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

raw.title: Software Engineer | Identity and Access Management | Full-Stack
raw.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.


Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.


The Identity and Access Management team owns DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, group, account, consent and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.


We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will contribute across the Identity services, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external customers and internal engineering teams.

Your responsibilities

  • Ship Features, Not Just Code: You will build well-scoped features from first commit to production. You won't just write functions in isolation; you will check that your code solves the actual user problem, works in production, and is covered by solid tests.

  • Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams, and learn from them. You will take part in code reviews and design discussions, and follow and help improve our shared standards. You ask for help early, and you speak up with questions or ideas when you think there is a better way.

  • Leverage Modern Tooling: You will use AI-assisted tools (like Copilot and Claude) to handle boilerplate and refactoring, allowing you to focus on logic and product value. We value engineers who use the best tools to ship faster.

  • Build for Quality: You will write well-tested, production-ready code that your team (and your future self) will thank you for. You understand that "speed" doesn't mean "sloppy"—it means building reliable software that doesn't break at 2am. You will participate in incident response, learn from postmortems, and help the team raise the bar on code quality and operational health.

Qualities we look for

  • Ownership and Reliability: You take responsibility for what you ship. You write tests, monitor your code in production, and follow through when things go wrong. You're proactive about flagging issues and asking for help when you need it, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn.

  • Strong Engineering Fundamentals: You have a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and clean coding principles. You can take a complex logic problem and break it down into small, solvable pieces. You are curious about what it takes to build and operate reliable, high throughput services, and keen to learn this hands-on.

  • Adaptability: You have a good foundation in backend development and server-side systems. Our stack relies on C#/.NET Core, Cassandra, gRPC, and Kubernetes. We don't expect you to be an expert in all of them today, but we expect you to be willing to jump in and learn whatever tool gets the job done.

  • Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.


What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

Lead UX/UI Designer

Fixed-term contract 6 months (maternity cover)

London — hybrid, with regular presence in our London office

Delta Capita is a global provider of managed services, technology and consulting to the financial services industry. Design sits at the centre of how we build our products. Our team shapes the interfaces our clients and their customers use every day.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Lead UX/UI Designer to cover a 6-month period of maternity leave, starting November 2026 and based in our London office. You will own the design of complex, multi-stakeholder products end to end - from early problem solving through to prototypes and production-ready UI. You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams on a day-to-day basis, with support from senior stakeholders as needed.

You will be comfortable making confident design decisions, shipping in short cycles, and iterating once real feedback arrives.You will be responsible for leading other junior designers in the team, to make help them make decisions, give feedback and make sure work is delivered to a high standard and on time.


Key responsibilities

  • Own complex projects end to end. Take full design accountability for one or more product workstreams, from early discovery through wireframes, prototypes and final UI specification.

  • Design and prototype. Produce interactive prototypes in Sketch to test flows, validate concepts with users and align stakeholders before build.

  • Run and facilitate workshops. Across teams and features, driving strategic alignment.

  • Maintain and evolve the design system. Extend our component library and design standards so that work across the team stays consistent, accessible and reusable.

  • Support junior designers. Set direction, review work, run critique sessions and support the day-to-day development of junior members of the design team.

  • Partner with product and engineering. Work closely with product managers to shape requirements, and with developers to ensure designs are implemented faithfully and are technically feasible.

  • Deliver at pace. Prioritise, break large problems into shippable increments and keep momentum across parallel workstreams.

  • Uphold accessibility and quality. Ensure designs meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards and our internal quality bar before handover.

Essential skills and experience

  • Proven track record as a lead UX/UI designer, with a portfolio demonstrating ownership of complex, large-scale digital products.

  • Advanced working knowledge of Sketch, including symbols, libraries and shared styles.

  • Strong prototyping ability - you can move from a rough concept to a testable interactive prototype quickly.

  • Demonstrable experience mentoring or line-managing junior designers.

  • Confident collaborating with product managers, engineers, business stakeholders and, where relevant, clients.

  • Evidence of delivering high-quality work at pace in an agile environment.

  • Excellent communication skills - you can explain and defend design decisions to non-designers.

  • Right to work in the UK (we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this fixed-term role).

Nice to have

  • Previous experience designing for fintech, banking or another regulated financial services environment.

  • Familiarity with Sketch

  • Exposure to enterprise or B2B products with dense interfaces and complex workflows.

  • Experience running user research and usability testing directly.

How We Work:

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please inform us.

This is a 6 months fixed term position based in London. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks.

 

Who We Are:

Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services.

Introduction to Demandbase:

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform.

As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.

About the Role

The Customer Success Manager II is responsible for growing, supporting, and renewing customer adoption of Demandbase solutions. This is accomplished by partnering with the client to achieve their objectives, driving customer adoption, accelerating time to live and value, and providing B2B digital business expertise.

Responsibilities

  • Own the customer relationship across the full lifecycle, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor to senior marketing stakeholders

  • Drive adoption and value realization of the Demandbase platform, measured through usage, customer outcomes, and goal attainment

  • Partner with customers to deliver proactive ABM best practices, strategies, and use cases, addressing critical success issues and executive priorities

  • Identify and support expansion opportunities within the customer base in partnership with new business teams

  • Lead customer onboarding, project manage ongoing initiatives, and ensure timely resolution of issues through cross-functional coordination

  • Advocate for customers internally while maintaining deep expertise in Demandbase products, industry trends, and the competitive landscape

  • Develop customer success stories, case studies, and references that demonstrate measurable impact

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic account management, customer success, or similar roles supporting SaaS customers

  • Demonstrated success driving expansion through upsell and cross-sell motions, in partnership with sales teams

  • Strong experience coordinating cross-functional teams and leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives

  • Deep familiarity with Sales and Marketing technology ecosystems, including CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, intent, predictive analytics, and revenue management tools

  • Proven ability to lead technical or process-driven implementations, identify gaps in customer workflows, and deliver measurable business impact and ROI

Benefits

Our benefits include options for up to 100% paid Medical and Vision premiums for employees, a flexible PTO policy, paid holidays, and access to mental health and wellness resources. We also provide a 401(k) with pre-tax, after tax, and roth options, as well as short-term/long-term disability, life insurance, and other great benefits.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis.

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

raw.description:
About Geordie AI

Geordie is building the security and governance platform that enables businesses to adopt AI agents safely and confidently.

As AI agents take on more work across businesses, organisations need to understand what those agents are doing, what they can access, the risks they create and how much they cost. Geordie gives businesses the visibility and control they need to manage AI agents as they scale.

We're building at the cutting edge of enterprise AI, helping organisations unlock the potential of AI while keeping it secure, accountable and under control. We're now looking for a creative, proactive Growth Marketing Associate to help bring our story to life and build Geordie's presence across social media.

2026 WINNER

RSA Conference Innovation Sandbox

2025 WINNER

Black Hat Europe Startup Spotlight

GARTNER

Cool Vendor 2026, AI Software Security

The Role

Reporting to the Head of Growth Marketing, you'll bring Geordie's content strategy to life with fresh ideas and creative execution.

You'll create content for our company social channels, lead influencer engagement, ghostwrite founder social posts and support employee posts, coordinating publishing wherever needed to amplify Geordie's social presence and reputation as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies.

You'll also film and edit short social clips and other video content, track what resonates with our audience, and support wider marketing activities.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating content, spotting opportunities and turning ideas into engaging marketing. You'll work closely with the Head of Growth Marketing and the wider team, with plenty of opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape how Geordie shows up in the market.

What You'll Do

  • Create social content: Develop engaging content for Geordie's company social channels, bringing our product, team and perspective on AI to life.

  • Support founder-led content: Ghostwrite social posts for our founders, helping communicate their ideas, insights and perspectives on the AI industry.

  • Coordinate employee advocacy: Help employees share content and ideas, making it easy for the wider team to contribute to Geordie's online presence.

  • Lead influencer engagement: Identify relevant creators and industry voices, build relationships and coordinate opportunities to collaborate.

  • Film and edit video: Produce short-form social clips and other video content that makes Geordie's story engaging and accessible.

  • Manage publishing: Coordinate content across channels, keeping publishing organised and ensuring content goes out consistently.

  • Track performance: Monitor engagement and identify which topics, formats and ideas resonate with our audience, using those insights to improve future content.

  • Support wider marketing: Get involved in broader marketing activities and help the team execute campaigns and initiatives as needed.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong content instinct: You understand what makes content interesting, engaging and worth sharing.

  • Excellent writing skills: You're able to write clearly and creatively, adapting your tone for company channels, founders and employees.

  • Creative execution: You enjoy coming up with ideas but, more importantly, can turn them into content that gets published.

  • Video skills: You're comfortable filming and editing short-form video content for social media.

  • Social media awareness: You understand how social platforms work and keep up with emerging formats, trends and creators.

  • Relationship-building skills: You're confident reaching out to influencers and coordinating with people across the business.

  • Organisation: You're able to manage multiple pieces of content and keep publishing on track.

  • A data-informed mindset: You pay attention to performance and use what you learn to improve your work.

  • Proactivity: You take ownership, bring fresh ideas and don't need to be told about every opportunity worth exploring.

LOVE WHAT YOU DO

An interest in AI and emerging technology would be particularly useful. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about the space and excited by the opportunity to help tell the story of a company working at its forefront.

Why Join Geordie?

Help shape a growing AI brand

Play a hands-on role in building Geordie's social presence and reputation.

Work at the cutting edge of AI

Be part of a company tackling the important challenge of making AI agents safe and scalable for businesses.

Work closely with leadership

Collaborate with the Head of Growth Marketing and founders to bring ideas and perspectives to a wider audience.

Have room to experiment

Test new formats, develop creative ideas and learn from what performs.

Make a visible impact

Help shape how customers, partners and the wider AI community understand Geordie and what we're building.


Our Values

 

Solve What Matters

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

Build, Learn, Iterate

We favour momentum over perfection - testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

Kind, Not Comfortable

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

A Platform for Your Best Work

We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

Agents are already at work. Help the world see how Geordie keeps them in check.

The Role

Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents safely — and we're growing fast. We're looking for a technical, customer-focused Technical Account Manager to own the post-sale relationship with our customers and make sure they get the best from their Geordie deployment, fast.

You'll be the technical face of Geordie for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — guiding onboarding and integration, becoming the go-to expert customers trust for anything technical, and working closely with our sales, product and engineering teams to keep our customers successful and growing. You will turn technical relationships into lasting partnerships.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll get deep into our platform, our customers' environments, and everything in between — and you'll help shape how Geordie delivers success for our customers as our first UK-based TAM hire.

We also expect you to work the way we build — intelligently and efficiently. That means embracing AI agents in your day-to-day workflows. We use tools like Claude Cowork to move faster and do more. If you're not passionate about that, this probably isn't the right place for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Technical Relationship — Be the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building trust from customer kick-off through renewal and expansion.

  • Project Management — Own the project plan for onboarding and major implementations end-to-end: timelines, milestones, resourcing, and risk tracking across customer, engineering, and product stakeholders. Run the cadence of standups/status calls, keep everyone accountable to dates, and escalate slippage before it becomes a surprise.

  • Onboarding & Implementation — Guide customers through deployment, integrations, and configuration, so they see value from day one.

  • Product Mastery — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Troubleshoot issues, answer technical questions, and give customers confidence in how we work.

  • Adoption & Health — Track account health and usage, spot risks early, and drive the actions that keep customers engaged and expanding.

  • Escalation Management — Be the calm, capable owner of technical escalations — coordinating with engineering and product teams to resolve issues and close the loop with customers.

  • Renewals & Expansion — Partner with our sales team to identify expansion opportunities and ensure strong technical health underpins every renewal opportunity.

  • Customer Advocacy — Bring field insights back to our teams — feature requests, friction points, and what's actually happening in customer environments — so we keep building the right things and ensure the customer remains at the centre of everything we do.

  • Documentation & Enablement — Build the runbooks, guides, and best-practice materials that make onboarding repeatable and support scalable.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with sales, engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

What We're Looking For

  • You're technical, and you like it. You're comfortable in the details — agents, APIs, integrations, security, governance — and you enjoy figuring out how things really work.

  • You own outcomes. You don't wait — you track account health and get ahead of risk before it becomes a churn conversation.

  • You're a builder. Early-stage means you create structure where there isn't any and find a way to provide value to customers.

  • You're AI-fluent, not just AI-aware. You use tools like Claude Cowork and other agentic AI to run your own workflow — drafting runbooks, triaging tickets, prepping QBRs, chasing account health signals — so you spend your time on judgement calls and relationships, not repetitive admin.   • You communicate clearly and often. Customers always know where things stand.

  • You're focused on success. Not just at renewal time — all the time. You care whether customers succeed, and it shows in how you show up.

  • You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — especially agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You thrive in ambiguity.

Requirements

  • Passion and interest in agents, how organisations are utilising them, their security and risk, and their governance.

  • Solid technical fluency — comfortable with agent architectures, agent security, agent tooling, APIs, SaaS/cloud integrations, and cloud environments.

  • Proven track record of owning post-sale relationships with enterprise customers, including onboarding, adoption, and renewal.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues, including coordinating with engineering teams on fixes.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work confidently with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong discovery and problem-solving skills — able to get to the root of a customer issue quickly.

  • Comfortable delivering polished, tailored product walkthroughs and training sessions independently.

  • Highly organised, with rigorous attention to detail across documentation, account health tracking, and follow-through.

  • Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

  • Based in the United Kingdom, with the right to work in the UK, and the flexibility to travel to customer sites as needed.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience supporting security, AI/ML, or agentic tooling customers.

  • Active experience creating, deploying and managing agents.

  • Prior experience at a high-growth Series A–B SaaS company.

  • Light scripting or coding ability (e.g. Python) and comfort working with API tools such as Postman.

  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS, Azure, or equivalent).

Why This Role

AI agents are changing how enterprises operate — and the question of how to govern them safely is becoming mission-critical. Geordie is the platform companies are turning to for that answer. As one of our first Technical Account Managers, you won't just be running a playbook — you'll be writing it. You'll have real influence over how we onboard, support, and grow our customers, and a direct line to Product on what to build next. If you want to go deep on a hard technical problem and build something that matters, this is it.

Our Values

Solve What Matters

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

Build, Learn, Iterate

We favour momentum over perfection — testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

Kind, Not Comfortable

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

sA Platform for Your Best Work

We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

Product Marketing Manager
raw.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.

This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.

You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.

As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.

The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.

Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

  • Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.

  • Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.

  • Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.

  • Become the developer community's champion by writing technical content at a regular cadence that Solutions Engineering uses in live deals, and answering architecture and integration questions directly rather than routing them to Product.

  • Build hx's position in actuarial AI by developing differentiated positioning and up-to-date competitive understanding that works consistently across website copy, enablement, and customer conversations.

  • Establish strong feedback loops between users, Product, Revenue, and the AI team, so insight from launches, testing, and field conversations directly informs messaging, prioritisation, and product direction.

What you'll need to have done

  • Led product marketing in a B2B SaaS environment, balancing adoption work for an existing product with launch readiness for a new one at the same time - demonstrating commercial judgement across multiple GTM motions.

  • Increased engagement or adoption of a mature product by using user insight to sharpen messaging or enablement - with measurable improvement in usage, understanding, or qualitative feedback from users and revenue teams.

  • Owned a product launch end to end, including the internal readiness and enablement work that happens before it ships - not just the moment it goes out.

  • Turned a complex technical capability into credible, differentiated messaging for a skeptical, technical audience - developers or an equivalent evaluator population - built on real user insight rather than generic claims.

  • Worked hands-on alongside a Solutions Engineer or equivalent technical partner, comfortable being challenged on technical detail and holding your line, and earning trust across Product, Engineering, and Revenue without relying on formal authority.

  • Used AI with real judgement about when a technical claim is actually true rather than just plausible, and applied that judgement to rebuild how systems like enablement, competitive intelligence, or win/loss work - not just run them faster.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

  • You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

  • You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Skills Assessment & Panel Interview

  4. Values Interview

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

CAM programming connects the drawing to repeatable precision production. Our central CAM team in London programmes parts for factories across the network, and how many new parts we can take on depends on it.

Reporting to: Senior Software Engineering Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

You’ll join the Security Engineering team, working alongside our cyber security leadership, architecture team and technical leaders across engineering. Our mission is to equip teams to build and innovate while upholding security best practice and protecting client data in the highly regulated energy sector.

  • Integrate security tooling and use AI to prevent, detect and respond to emerging threats

  • Work with senior technical leadership to shape our technical strategy and solutions architecture, so security, risk and compliance feed into technical decisions

  • Help product teams deliver secure systems quickly by building a strong security culture through mentoring, design reviews and training

  • Give product and engineering teams practical guidance on identifying, prioritising and mitigating systemic risks and vulnerabilities

  • Lead the evolution of our security best practice across application development and the wider SDLC, supporting teams with expert advice and automation

  • Influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across Kaluza and client teams

  • Mentor and coach security and software engineers to balance risk with speed and quality

  • Build relationships with third-party security vendors and industry bodies to keep us at the forefront of emerging practices, tooling and standards


What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Extensive experience mentoring engineers and collaborating closely (e.g. pairing, swarming)

  • Deep understanding of software security flaws and web application security best practice (OWASP Top 10, CWE/SANS Top 25)

  • Extensive knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps principles, and their security considerations

  • Experience applying AI in your own work and helping others build it safely into how they develop

  • Scripting skills and first-hand experience of software development at scale

  • Working knowledge of Okta or equivalent, to enable workforce identity and enforce access management policies

  • Awareness of AWS and/or GCP security best practice, and some experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform)

  • Experience applying architectural and software design patterns in a complex environment

You’ll also be:

  • A pragmatic, risk-based decision-maker who weighs the technical and commercial consequences of your choices

  • Skilled at influencing upwards and outwards, with great communication skills

  • Able to set a clear vision for large-scale technical direction and align multiple teams behind it

  • Keen to drive compliance and NFR improvements that balance information security and commercial goals

  • Committed to a culture of learning and improvement, and willing to challenge engineering leadership to support it

Skills (SFIA): We use the SFIA framework to assess and develop our security engineers. Levels run from 1 to 7.

Essential:

  • Level 6: Systems design

  • Level 5: Information security, specialist advice, systems development lifecycle, solution architecture, emerging technology monitoring

  • Level 4: Information assurance, information and data compliance

Desirable: Identity and access management (Level 5), software development (Level 6), learning delivery (Level 3), and information assurance stepping up to Level 5


Our values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday [plus/including bank holidays], plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn, or read our Applicant Data Protection Policy.

raw.description:

Level: Engineer C2

Team: Product & Tech Business Operations

Salary: £45,600 - £57,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Business Operations

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

You'll own and evolve the technical systems that power P&T Business Operations — Jira architectures, data pipelines, dashboards, and integrations with enterprise platforms. You identify where operational capability could be stronger, scope those opportunities, and design and build solutions in collaboration with the Business Operations Manager. You approach problems with an AI-first mindset and make technical decisions with clarity about trade-offs.

  • Own and evolve the standardisation of Jira and other Kaluza data systems. Configure, extend, and redesign them to support increasingly complex business operations.

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and dashboards that turn raw operations data into clear signals for decision-making. Explore where AI agents and autonomous systems can streamline operations.

  • Identify opportunities for new capabilities (better delivery planning data & tooling capabilities, improved management insights solutions, plugging into adjacent Kaluza products) and design and build solutions, aligned with the direction from the business operations manager who will lead the product & delivery enablement side of things

  • Connect and integrate internal products and platforms — Workday integrations, locally-built internal tools, and other solutions. Make recommendations on what to build, integrate, or take over — clearly articulating trade-offs, impact, and delivery path.

  • Anticipate security, compliance, and regulatory constraints upfront. Navigate Kaluza's systems to unblock delivery quickly.

  • Spot when something's off — in the data, in a process, or in a tool — and fix it before it becomes someone else's problem.

  • Iterate on our operational tooling continuously, testing new approaches early and sharing what you learn openly with the team.


What you'll bring

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • 3–5 years building and maintaining operational tooling — not just writing code, but owning what you ship.

  • Strong Jira expertise (including JQL) and Confluence; comfortable configuring them for complex portfolio structures.

  • Experience with APIs/integrations and data exchange, SQL + basic scripting, BI tools, AI tools and automation.

  • Experience building data pipelines or automated workflows with practical understanding of keeping them reliable at scale.

  • Confident in identifying improvements and implementing them independently. You break down ambiguous problems, scope solutions, and drive delivery without constant prompting. You don't wait to be told what's next.

  • Comfortable with data analysis, ambiguity, and working in scaling organisations where processes and systems need to grow as fast as the people using them.

  • You navigate Kaluza's systems to move fast. You share progress openly and communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.

What will set you apart:

  • You're the kind of person who spots a constraint, maps it back to its root cause, and builds a fix (or identifies where a temporary workaround is needed, whilst you work on a fix). You set a high bar for your own work and raise it over time, and you're not satisfied leaving a system in a worse state than you found it.

  • You work openly by default: you share progress, flag blockers early, and communicate what's working and what isn't without waiting to be asked. People across the organisation find it easy to understand what you're doing and why.

  • You're genuinely curious about new tools and approaches — especially AI — and you actively bring others along by sharing what you've tried, what landed, and what didn't. Learning in the open comes naturally to you.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Team: Quality & Release

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: VP Engineering

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

The quality engineering function is shifting  from manual oversight and process governance toward an AI-assisted product development lifecycle where QA leads its own domain test strategy and bespoke tooling drives automation maturity.  This role will drive this shift in our organization and ways of working. 

You will own quality and release governance at programme level, directly manage an engineering team building AI-assisted automation and test data capability, and set the standard that QA leads across delivery streams work to. You will be as comfortable driving change as you are accountable for outcomes. Responsibilities will include:

Strategic Quality Leadership

  • Own and evolve the quality strategy across delivery streams, aligned to programme objectives and client SLAs

  • Define and maintain release governance frameworks — release readiness criteria, risk acceptance, and sign-off authorities

  • Set quality standards and coverage expectations; ensure QA leads translate these into domain-level test strategies

  • Drive defect governance at programme level — internal and client-facing SLA compliance

  • Represent quality and risk in senior leadership, architecture, and product forums

AI-Driven Tooling & Automation

  • Directly manage a team of engineers building and maintaining bespoke automation tooling, leveraging AI and LLM capabilities

  • Own the test data management strategy — including AI-assisted synthetic data generation and environment data integrity

  • Evaluate and select off-the-shelf AI testing tools; define governance frameworks for their use and validation

  • Ensure governance gates are maintained as AI participation in the PDLC grows — accountable humans must remain in the loop for risk acceptance and production judgement

  • Establish tooling standards that QA leads can adopt across domains without creating dependency on a central bottleneck

QA Function Leadership & Operating Model

  • Lead, develop, and performance-manage QA leads embedded across domains; define the operating model and career framework for the function

  • Own the accountability split clearly: QA leads own test strategy and tooling choices for their domain; this role owns the standard they work to

  • Drive consistency across streams without becoming a handoff point — enable QA leads to move fast within well-defined guardrails

  • Build a quality engineering culture — not a bug-finding one

Change Management & Adoption

  • Lead the transformation of QA practice from script maintenance to intelligent, risk-based, AI-assisted quality engineering

  • Drive upskilling across the function — building capability in AI tooling, context engineering, and agent-assisted workflows

  • Manage resistance and build confidence in new ways of working; bring the team through change without losing them

  • Communicate quality outcomes in business terms to senior stakeholders — escaped defect rates, release stability, risk posture

Release Management

  • Own the release quality process end-to-end: environment strategy, regression coverage, go/no-go decisions, and post-release monitoring

  • Embed shift-left practices — quality gates early in the PDLC, not just at release

  • Manage the tension between delivery velocity and release stability, particularly as AI-generated code volumes increase


What you’ll bring
Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Proven track record leading a QA or quality engineering function of significant scale — including embedded domain leads and direct management of practitioners

  • Has directly managed engineers building tooling or automation infrastructure — not just managed QA practitioners executing test plans

  • Has delivered a meaningful QA transformation: AI adoption, automation maturity uplift, defect governance overhaul, or similar

  • Has worked in a multi-client or multi-product platform environment, managing quality outcomes across concurrent delivery streams

  • Has owned release governance in a complex, multi-stream delivery context — including go/no-go accountability

  • Exposure to energy, utilities, billing, or similarly regulated complex domains is a plus — not essential
    Strong grounding in test strategy, automation frameworks, and CI/CD integration — sufficient to credibly lead engineers building these things

  • Working knowledge of LLMs and AI tooling in a QA context: test generation, defect triage, coverage analysis, synthetic test data

  • Understands test data management principles and the challenges of environment data integrity at scale

  • Able to evaluate build vs. buy for tooling; assess AI testing platforms with appropriate scepticism
    Comfortable setting strategy and being accountable for outcomes — not just owning process

  • Able to operate at programme level with senior engineering and product stakeholders

  • Experienced in leading distributed, multi-timezone quality functions

  • Strong communicator — translates quality metrics into business outcomes; can make the case for investment in tooling and governance
    Demonstrated experience leading practice transformation in an engineering context

  • Able to bring people with them through transitions that challenge established ways of working

  • Comfortable with ambiguity; can hold direction steady while the detail is still being worked out

  • Familiar with observability, production monitoring, and shift-right quality practices


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

What you’ll do

As Head of Product for Flex, you own the vision, strategy and commercial success of our residential VPP platform globally. You lead a product organisation of Product Managers embedded across our device integration, optimisation, monetisation and SaaS platform teams, and you sit on the Flex Leadership team alongside our Head of Engineering, jointly accountable for the performance of the whole Flex business. Specifically, you will:

  • Set and own the global product strategy for Flex, translating Kaluza's company-level strategy into a roadmap spanning device integrations, multi-asset optimisation (EV, battery, solar, HEMS), monetisation and market access, and self-serve SaaS capabilities.

  • Make the trade-off calls that matter: balance the needs of our two core client segments - energy retailers and device OEMs - defaulting to retailer priorities where they conflict, in line with Flex's strategy, while protecting the long-term health of the platform.

  • Partner closely with the Head of Engineering and our Commercial and Partnerships teams to align product, technical and commercial strategy, and to make resourcing and investment decisions across Flex's product and engineering teams.

  • Be a proven, experienced product leader with a track record of building, leading and developing product teams and people managers, not just individual contributors.

  • Be a seasoned expert in product strategy and execution across the full product lifecycle, with a track record of translating ambiguous, complex problems into a clear strategy and roadmap.

  • Have strong commercial instincts - comfortable owning pricing input, business cases and ROI, and able to demonstrate commercial impact and business growth through your teams.

  • Be an excellent communicator, able to present complex, ambiguous problems clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, from engineers to clients to Kaluza's leadership team.

  • Have deep experience with, or a genuine ability to quickly get up to speed in, complex multi-sided B2B / B2B2C technology platforms - direct experience in energy, DER orchestration, IoT device platforms or smart devices is a strong plus.

  • Be comfortable operating with high ambiguity, making the call yourself where appropriate and knowing when to escalate, in a fast-paced and frequently changing environment.

  • Have a track record of fostering a strong product culture and coaching others - including peers without being their formal manager - to raise the standard of product work around them.

  • Be data-driven in how you measure impact, and able to hold yourself and your teams accountable to outcomes, not just outputs.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience in energy trading, national and regional flexibility markets, or other VPP monetisation opportunity spaces (e.g. balancing markets, capacity markets, wholesale/imbalance trading, ancillary services).

raw.description:
Tech Specialist (Front-end & Design System) TL1

  • Location: London, UK - Hybrid

  • Team: Global Engineering - Commerce & Customer Care

  • Visa: This role is based in the UK and requires existing right to work in the UK.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You will be fully embedded in the Customer Care org, specifically working on KAE (Kaluza Agent Experience) which is integral to building and enabling an energy specific agent product for servicing customers across multiple channels and the enterprise design system (Nebula) that will enable the next phase of scale for Kaluza. You will be the design system technical expert for the team and the hands-on bridge between design and engineering, turning design intent into accessible, production-quality React components and patterns, bolstering the existing team members with specific technical depth in building and scaling design systems across internal teams. You will work with designers as equal partners.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Working in a product development team with internal users to understand emerging and existing needs to steer the development of the enterprise design system, and supporting the teams who build with it

  • Working closely with designers as equal partners, and with product and engineering, to help shape the future of the global Agent Experience product and the design system

  • Designing, building and shipping React components and patterns that conform to WCAG 2.2 AA to help the team meet their delivery goals

  • Reviewing code from your colleagues, including contributions from outside the team, and setting the quality bar for design fidelity and accessibility

  • Making the design-to-code workflow work in practice, including design tokens, handoff and component documentation

  • Running the contribution process so that teams beyond our own can propose, build and ship into the design system, and leading changes that affect several apps from first proposal to final migration

  • Creating and delivering against the technical strategy for your team in partnership with the engineering manager

  • Promoting engineering, design and delivery best practices within the team, and coaching the engineers and designers who use the design system

  • Shaping how we use AI-assisted development in design system work

  • Championing progressive architecture and reviewing design solutions with other engineering leaders

  • Representing the design system to engineering and wider stakeholders, and helping set its direction

  • Working within a team of other senior leaders responsible for designing and evolving the architecture of the enterprise design system at Kaluza

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Deep experience building Frontend components with React and TypeScript

  • Deep experience designing, building and running design systems, including tokens, component APIs, documentation and versioning

  • Knowledge of implementing and maintaining WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, with practical empathy for users with accessibility needs

  • Good design and UX judgement, starting from the user, and comfortable challenging and being challenged by designers

  • Experience running changes across multiple apps

  • Strong communication skills, comfortable working with stakeholders across engineering, design, product and the wider business, holding opinions loosely and raising what matters even when it is inconvenient

  • A bias to action and a ‘Can do’ approach to problem solving in the face of uncertainty

  • Experience of mentoring, training and developing other engineers

  • An ability to deliver against a technical strategy iteratively, working through ambiguity to deliver change over longer periods

  • Experience of building and nurturing highly collaborative and engaged teams

  • Comfort with AI-enabled development, ideally leading others in using it well

  • An ability to collaborate with people managers, product managers and agile practitioners to contribute to a high-performing culture

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme

  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme

  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP

  • Life Assurance

  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app

  • Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests

  • Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts

  • 5% Flex Fund - to spend on the benefits you want most

  • 26 days holiday

  • Flexible Bank Holidays - Giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like

  • Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family

  • Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow!

  • Home Office Budget

  • And more!

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.
