raw.title: Sales Manager, Startups | New Business UK&I
raw.description:
About the team

The OpenAI Startups team helps founders build and scale products with AI. We combine technical understanding, commercial judgement and startup ecosystem relationships to help customers move from promising ideas to building and scaling their businesses with OpenAI.

About the role

You will lead one of our EMEA Greenfield sales teams, helping high-potential startups choose OpenAI, reach production and establish the foundations for growth. Greenfield covers two distinct motions: Early Stage, focused on activation and meaningful expansion, and Pursuits, focused on high-stakes conversion of the startups with highest potential and new customers with complex buying decisions.

You will translate regional strategy into clear account priorities, hire and develop Account Directors, and coach the customer and commercial work appropriate to the team you lead. You will work closely with technical partners and VC Partnerships to turn founder access and technical engagement into customer value, qualified pipeline and consumption revenue.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week.

In this role, you'll:

  • Recruit, onboard and develop a strong team of Account Directors. Set clear expectations, coach live customer work, sales methodology and deal strategy, as well as giving direct, actionable feedback.

  • Build and execute the Greenfield GTM strategy and sales plan for your team. Prioritise companies using customer need, workload, decision timing, founder and funding signals, commercial potential and available technical capacity.

  • Coach the motion your sellers own. For Early Stage, strengthen discovery, activation, first production use and initial growth. For Pursuits, strengthen competitive strategy, executive access, evaluation, migration planning and negotiation.

  • Create a disciplined pipeline and consumption forecasting rhythm. Connect opportunity stages and revenue expectations to customer evidence, production milestones and specific next decisions.

  • Build trusted relationships with founders, technical leaders and commercial decision-makers. Help the team explain how OpenAI can improve product quality, delivery speed and economics for the customer’s workload.

  • Partner with VC Partnerships, Marketing and developer-facing teams on qualified sourcing and activation. Match direct sales effort, nurture and scaled engagement to customer intent and potential.

  • Align with Solutions and AI Engineering on technical scope, evaluation criteria and support capacity. Bring in Product, Deal Desk, Legal and other partners when their expertise can advance the customer’s decision.

  • Turn technical success into a credible commercial path and sustained paid adoption. Use approved programmes and commercial processes, and ensure customer commitments reflect a realistic production and consumption plan.

  • Build reusable discovery guides, sales plays, competitive playbooks and migration plans. Route routine billing, credits and support requests to the right channels while retaining clear ownership of material customer blockers.

  • Coordinate account transitions with Core and strategic coverage. Preserve customer context, relationships and the next growth plan, and keep ownership clear until a handoff is accepted.

We're seeking someone with experience including:

  • Six or more years leading sales teams, including hiring, developing and managing technical sellers in fast-changing markets.

  • Working closely with startups as a founder, early employee or commercial leader serving startup customers.

  • Selling platform or software products in a product-led or consumption-based business, with a record of converting technical adoption into revenue.

  • Leading the relevant Greenfield motion: scalable early-stage acquisition and activation, or complex competitive pursuits and production migrations.

  • Building repeatable sales processes while preserving judgement about customer fit, account priority and the right level of support.

  • Coaching both technical and commercial discovery, qualifying opportunities and managing evidence-based forecasts.

  • Discussing AI applications, APIs, model evaluation and production economics credibly with founders and technical leaders, while drawing on specialist expertise when needed.

  • Working across technical, product, marketing, operational and commercial teams, and translating customer learning into better products and programmes.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • You understand founder urgency, earn trust through useful advice and communicate candidly about what is possible. You need to be comfortable with ambiguity and creating clarity and direction in an ever-changing landscape and priorities. You are curious about AI, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to learn quickly. You enjoy developing sellers and building systems that make a growing team more effective.

What success looks like:

Your team reaches the right startups early, advances customers into meaningful production use and builds a healthy path to customer value and growth. Qualified pursuits progress through clear technical and commercial decisions. Sellers become more capable, forecasts become more reliable, and the team scales its reach through repeatable programmes and effective handoffs.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

Location: London, United Kingdom

Why This Role is Exciting

If you thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment and are passionate about driving business transformation, join our innovative, growing sales team at Optro as an Enterprise Account Executive. Recognized for our commitment to workplace excellence, we foster a supportive culture where your growth and success are our top priorities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of an Enterprise territory of both large publicly listed and privately held accounts, driving growth with both new logo acquisition and existing logo expansion

  • Operate from the London office in a hybrid model

  • Report directly to our Area Director EMEA as an individual contributor.

  • Become a trusted advisor to prospect accounts and existing customers, showcasing your industry expertise and high EQ

  • Link AuditBoard's leading technology to robust business cases that secure CFO approval and Executive Sponsorship 

  • Collaborate with Sales Engineering, Demand Generation, and Business Value Consulting, throughout your sales cycles

  • Create opportunities using innovative ideas and new techniques, tools, joint field marketing initiatives, trade shows, and partners

  • Collaborate with our Big 4 Alliance partners to build strong, mutually beneficial relationships that focus on customer-centric outcomes

  • Win deals through meticulous planning and preparation, adopting a consultative approach to solving real business problems, alongside flawless execution of legal and IT security negotiations/onboarding

Attributes for a Successful Candidate

  • Minimum of 5-7 years experience working with enterprise technology

  • Experience with complex sales cycles

  • Affinity for software, IT security, and risk management solutions.

  • Proven success in securing new logos and value selling.

  • Passionate focus on Pipeline Generation & Opportunity Progression, including strategic planning and preparation.

  • Desire to be coached and a structured approach to work with a defined sales process.

  • Experience in collaborating with other departments, partners, and team members to achieve success.

  • An 'in the field' mentality that drives you to meet customers and prospects face-to-face whenever possible.

You’ll Benefit From:

  • Support from a team that cares about your success, consisting of peers and leaders dedicated to your growth.

  • Access to well-planned support, continuous learning, and expertise in the marketplace.

  • Investment in your personal and professional growth, with rewards for your achievements.

  • An environment characterized by collaboration and team success.

  • Flexible home-based remote work policy - with 2 days in the office 

  • Access to the London Optro office to connect with colleagues.

Perks (United Kingdom)

  • Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA!

  • Live your best life (LYBL)! $200/mo (USD) for anything that enhances your life

  • Comprehensive employee health coverage

  • Pension scheme with company contributions

  • Competitive compensation & bonus program

  • Generous annual leave of 25 days plus bank holidays

  • Time off for your birthday & volunteering

  • Employee resource groups

  • Opportunities for team and company-wide get-togethers!

*perks may vary based on eligibility/location

Our Company Values

  • Customer obsession: It starts and ends here. Consistently ask yourself how what you’re doing creates value for our customers. It’s a mindset.

  • Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes.

  • Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next.

  • Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success.

  • Growth mindset: 10x, not 10%. Think in orders of magnitude, not increments. Seek feedback, learn, and improve.

We love building strong partnerships, but please note that Optro cannot accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Any submissions without a signed agreement in place will not create a fee obligation.

Privacy Notice for Candidates
When you apply for a role at Optro, we collect and process personal data including your contact details, resume, work history, and application responses to evaluate your candidacy. For full details on how we collect, use, and protect your data — including your rights under GDPR, UK GDPR, and US state privacy laws and other applicable data protection laws — please review our Candidate Privacy Notice.

  • Use of AI in Recruitment: Optro may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to assist in the screening and evaluation of applications, including resume parsing and candidate matching. These tools do not make final hiring decisions — all assessments are reviewed by our human recruitment team. You may opt out of AI-assisted screening at any time without impact to your candidacy by contacting Interview Recording: Optro may use recording and transcription technology during interviews. You will be notified before any recording begins and may opt out at any time without affecting your candidacy.

  • Background Checks: Background checks are required for this role. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. This role may have access to highly sensitive data, including employee data, customer data, company financials, and proprietary product information.

Optro does not sell candidate personal data.

Questions? Contact Optro's Privacy Team at

raw.title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers

already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers,

technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly

shape the value customers get from Perk.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.

Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for

generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product

and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with.

You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and

manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work

closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences.

This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should

work as we scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI.

  • Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences.

  • Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations.

  • Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value.

  • Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals.

  • Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers.

  • Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

  • Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

  • Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

  • Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders.

  • Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority.

  • Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook.

  • Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems.

  • Experience managing relationships with major business software, technology, mobility, or AI platforms.

  • Familiarity with unified API or integration-platform models.

  • Experience with European ERP and accounting ecosystems across markets such as DACH, Benelux, France, the Nordics, or the UK.

  • Additional European languages.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60 mins - IRL / Virtual

  • Values interview - 30 mins - Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

raw.title: Compliance Manager
raw.description:
About us

Plentific is pioneering real-time property operations for real-world impact. Our Software as a Service (SaaS) platform connects owners, operators, service providers and residents. We work with housing associations, local authorities, student housing, later living and build-to-rent operators, across a growing network of 1.7M+ properties and 5,000+ service providers worldwide, reaching 3M+ engaged residents.

Our customers trust us with their residents’ data, their supply chains and their money. This role makes sure that trust is earned every day.

Mission

You'll run Plentific’s compliance programme day to day: KYC, data protection, ISO 27001, business risk and internal audit. You’ll make it practical, evidence-based and quick, using AI tools to do in hours what used to take days.

What you’ll own

  • KYC and due diligence

  • Data protection

  • ISO 27001 ISMS

  • Business risk register

  • Internal audit programme

  • Compliance policies and training

What you’ll do

KYC and due diligence

  • Run KYC checks on customers, suppliers and service providers: identity, ownership, sanctions, PEP and adverse media.

  • Set risk-based rules for when enhanced due diligence applies, and escalate cases that need a decision.

  • Keep KYC records complete and ready for audit or client review.

Data protection

  • Run day-to-day UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 compliance: records of processing, DPIAs, retention and data subject requests.

  • Review data processing agreements and supplier privacy terms with the legal team.

  • Manage personal data incidents from first report to close, including the decision on whether to notify the ICO within 72 hours.

Information security (ISO 27001)

  • Maintain the ISMS with Information Security Team: Statement of Applicability, risk treatment plan, control owners and evidence, etc.

  • Lead surveillance and recertification audits with our external certification body.

  • Answer security and compliance questionnaires from housing association and local authority clients.

Business risk and internal audit

  • Own the business risk register. Work with risk owners to rate, treat and report risks to the General Counsel and leadership team.

  • Plan and run an annual internal audit programme across information security, data protection and KYC, and track every finding to closure.

  • Report on compliance status and open risks in a format leadership can act on.

Policies, training and AI

  • Keep compliance policies current, short and written so people actually read them.

  • Run awareness training on data protection, information security and KYC.

  • Use AI tools every day to draft policies, review questionnaires and contracts, gather audit evidence and track regulatory change. Automate the repetitive checks.

  • Help shape how Plentific governs its own use of AI.

What you’ll need

  • 3+ years in a compliance, risk or information governance role, ideally in SaaS, fintech or another regulated tech business.

  • Good working knowledge of KYC checks, including sanctions, PEP and beneficial ownership screening, and the tools used to run them.

  • Hands-on experience of UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018: DPIAs, data subject requests, breach handling and supplier due diligence.

  • Experience running or supporting an ISO 27001 ISMS through certification and surveillance audits.

  • A track record of managing a business risk register and conducting internal audits. An ISO 27001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor qualification helps.

  • A CIPP/E or CIPM certification is beneficial.

  • AI training credentials are beneficial, such as the IAPP AIGP or an ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer course.

  • You use AI tools daily and can give real examples of how they made your work faster or better.

  • Clear writing, and the confidence to explain a compliance requirement to an engineer, a salesperson or a client.

Nice to have

  • Experience of AI governance, such as the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Not essential: if you don’t have it yet, you’ll learn it on the job.

Why Plentific

You'll join a scale up with ambitious growth plans and the backing to deliver them, in a role where you'll impact the future of housing:

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped OTE

  • 25 days annual holiday

  • Flexible working, including a work abroad scheme

  • Private healthcare for you and immediate family, with discounted gym membership, optical, dental and private GP

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance (4x salary)

  • Pension scheme

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary sacrifice scheme

  • Learning platform powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation if someone you introduce joins

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle and Techscheme programmes

  • Company-sponsored lunches, dinners and social events, plus a fully stocked kitchen

raw.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Snyk is the leader in secure AI software development, helping millions of developers develop fast and stay secure as AI transforms how software is built. Our AI-native Developer Security Platform integrates seamlessly into development and security workflows, making it easy to find, fix, and prevent vulnerabilities — from code and dependencies to containers and cloud.

 

Our mission is to empower every developer to innovate securely in the AI era — boosting productivity while reducing business risk. We’re not your average security company - we build Snyk on One Team, Care Deeply, Customer Centric, and Forward Thinking.

 

It’s how we stay driven, supportive, and always one step ahead as AI reshapes our world.

 

Our Opportunity

We're seeking a talented and results-oriented AI Systems Engineer to join our growing team! You'll be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying innovative AI solutions that empower our internal operations and drive business value.

 

You’ll Spend Your Time:

  • Building and maintaining internal AI systems: Develop and maintain software pipelines for training, deploying, and monitoring machine learning and Gen. AI projects used for various internal tasks (e.g., knowledge management, data analysis, process automation, decision support).

  • Optimizing AI infrastructure: Collaborate on optimizing our AI infrastructure for scalability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.

  • Performing data integration and engineering: Ensure seamless data flow for AI projects by integrating data from various sources and performing necessary cleaning and transformation.

  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders: Partner closely with data scientists and business teams to understand their needs and translate them into effective AI solutions.

 

What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development

  • Proficiency in programming languages especially Python

  • Experience building full stack applications and owning the end to end delivery

  • Experience with deploying applications to cloud platforms ( eg GCP ) and Kubernetes

  • Experience with generative AI concepts, frameworks and models ( eg. Langchain, OpenAI)

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

 

We’d be Lucky if You:

  • Have built and managed production grade RAG systems using Langchain/Langgraph

  • Have experience of preparing data for ingestion by AI systems

 

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

raw.title: Staff Data Engineer
raw.description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

Staff Data Engineer

At Sparta, we're on a mission to build the next generation of commodity trading platforms - replacing the fragmented tools traders depend on with a single, powerful dashboard. Our product is a data-driven platform that aggregates real-time feeds from across the commodities domain, transforming them into intuitive, actionable visualisations within one unified interface. Users can explore pre-built data views or build their own custom formulas - turning raw market data into decisions.

At the heart of Sparta is a serious data engineering challenge. We're building a platform that enables the rapid development of reliable, scalable ETL pipelines - the foundation everything else depends on. As our data volumes grow and our product ambitions expand, the demands on that infrastructure grow with them. We're looking for experienced data engineers who are familiar with these challenges at scale — people who understand what it takes to keep a data platform performing as complexity increases.

We want people who thrive with ownership. At Sparta, you'll be handed problems, not solutions - and we expect you to run with them. Speed matters, autonomy is real, and we'd rather you move fast and course-correct than wait for permission. As a Staff engineer, you'll also be shaping the direction of the platform itself: engaging directly with stakeholders, contributing to product thinking, and investing meaningfully in the engineers around you.

This role can be based in the UK (London) or Spain (Barcelona, Madrid), and we would expect to spend some time together with the team in-office (2 -3 days a week).

Core Responsibilities

  • Play a leading role in the design, build, and ongoing evolution of scalable data pipelines and ETL frameworks that power both real-time and analytical data processing.

  • Take shared ownership of the health and performance of our data platform - optimising for latency, throughput, and reliability at scale.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure data infrastructure aligns with product goals and trader-facing outcomes - acting as the connective tissue between data and backend engineering.

  • Drive architectural decisions across our data platform, with a focus on pipeline reliability, data quality, and scalability.

  • Contribute to the definition of our target architecture - shaping how we ingest, transform, store, and serve data as the platform evolves.

  • Mentor and support other engineers through design reviews, technical discussions, and hands-on knowledge sharing.

Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience as a data or software engineer, with a strong track record of delivering production-quality data systems.

  • 2+ years working within a product-focused organisation, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Proven experience building and scaling data-intensive pipelines and platforms in production environments.

  • Deep understanding of stream and batch processing frameworks - hands-on experience with Flink or Spark is essential.

  • Comfortable working across multiple programming languages - we primarily work with Kotlin, Python, and TypeScript.

  • Equally comfortable designing high-level architecture as diving deep into low-level implementation details.

  • Experienced in designing and deploying data infrastructure in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP.

  • Hands-on experience with core data infrastructure tooling such as Kafka, Redis, and/or clustered Postgres.

Nice to have experience

  • Familiarity with open lakehouse technologies, such as Apache Iceberg and dbt.

  • Experience building data infrastructure to support AI agents - including low-latency retrieval and analytical interfaces.

  • Experience leading teams or managing engineers, driving both delivery and technical excellence.

  • Exposure to complex distributed environments with demanding constraints such as high throughput, low latency, or large-scale datasets.

Working style

Whereas Sparta is a remote-first company, for this role we’re looking for someone who values a hybrid working style, which in a typical week could involve spending a couple of days in the office - with flexibility built in.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

raw.title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
raw.description:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

raw.title: Workplace Manager - UK
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.

About the team

At Trustly, our employees are our users and the workplace is the product we build for them. The Workplace Experience team runs our offices in London, Paris, Stockholm, Lisbon, New York and San Francisco. We’re small, close-knit and obsessed with detail. We want every colleague and guest to feel looked after from the moment they walk in.

We’re also changing how workplace teams work. We treat the workplace as a system we can test, learn from and improve, and we’re putting AI at the centre of how we do it. That means automating the repetitive work so we can spend our time on the human moments that make Trustly a great place to work.

About the role

London is one of our biggest hubs, and you’ll own the experience there. You’ll shape the culture people feel every day: how they’re welcomed, how they connect, and how easy it is for them to do their best work.

This isn’t a role for keeping things ticking over. You’ll spot friction, fix it, and find smarter ways to deliver great service, often with AI tools we’re building and testing as a team. You’ll work closely with the Director of Workplace and help shape how our global team works.

What you’ll do

  • Own the London office experience end to end, so colleagues and guests always get a warm, professional welcome

  • Build culture through events, rituals and moments that bring people together and make Trustly feel like Trustly

  • Find friction in the employee experience and remove it, using data, feedback and quick experiments

  • Pilot and adopt AI tools and automations that make our service faster, smarter and more personal

  • Run day-to-day office operations, including maintenance, building management, purchasing and suppliers

  • Keep the office safe and secure

  • Partner with People, IT, Finance and other teams so the employee experience feels seamless

  • Lead local and global projects with the Director of Workplace

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of work experience, including 2 to 3 years as an Office or Workplace Manager

  • You’ve built employee engagement or culture programmes and seen the impact

  • You’re curious about AI and want to use it to change how work gets done

  • You think in systems: you fix the underlying cause, not just the symptom

  • You run projects well and care about the details people notice

  • You’re energised by fast-moving, changing environments

  • You’re warm, clear and confident with everyone from new joiners to senior leaders

  • You’re happy to roll up your sleeves and get things done

raw.title: Partner Sales Executive
raw.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As a Partner Sales Executive focused on Financial Crime Compliance (FCC), you'll navigate partner ecosystems, building strong executive relationships, trust, and new revenue streams through value-based selling. You'll grow revenue and drive adoption of the UiPath platform for FCC use cases — such as anti-money laundering, KYC, and fraud — by partnering with world-class consulting and service organizations, and build the plans that help those partners deliver maximum success for their financial services customers.

This is a unique overlay role: you'll drive partner sales for FCC across the entire company, and no two days will look the same. You'll build offerings and go-to-market strategies — and see them through to execution — with sophisticated, non-transactional partners such as global systems integrators and advisory firms.

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Analyze market potential and build strategic go-to-market plans with partners to maximize revenue

  • Hit agreed sales targets and outcomes each quarter, growing partner-sourced revenue, registered deals, and joint solutions

  • Evangelize the UiPath brand and value proposition so UiPath becomes the automation platform of choice for your partners' customers

  • Show partners how our solutions benefit their customers financially and support their strategic initiatives

  • Build trusted relationships with partner automation practices, account owners, vertical leaders, and executives

  • Work with regional sales leadership and partner leadership on a coordinated go-to-market strategy for high-value solutions

  • Coach UiPath sales reps on working with your partner, managing joint pursuits and keeping communication tight

  • Respond quickly to partner leads, agree deal-support priorities, and nurture opportunities into expansion

  • Drive ongoing partner enablement: training and certification, product updates, quotes, and new release information

  • Team up with field sales, Customer Success Managers, and pre-sales to make sure customers get maximum value and issues are resolved fast

  • Track competitors, new products, and market conditions, and report partner needs, competitive activity, and new opportunities to leadership

  • Keep the UiPath CRM accurate and up to date

What you'll bring to the team

  • 10+ years of business and sales experience, including developing sales with partners and building offerings and go-to-market strategies with sophisticated partners (consulting backgrounds welcome)

  • 2–3 years of industry experience in financial crime compliance, either at a bank or with a vendor in the FCC space (vendor experience is a strong plus)

  • The credibility to hold solid, in-depth conversations on financial crime topics with partners, customers, and compliance leaders

  • Solid knowledge of the automation and AI landscape, and the ability to explain UiPath's key differentiators and customer benefits

  • A track record of building multiple senior-level relationships across a partner ecosystem, including the leaders who shape go-to-market strategy and own key client relationships

  • Experience building account plans that meet sales and profit goals, and taking full ownership of partners across assigned verticals or geographies

  • An agile, confident problem solver who is organizationally savvy and disciplined in execution

  • A proactive self-starter with superlative collaboration and communication skills

  • The ability to handle conflict constructively and balance the interests of the partner, the customer, and UiPath to reach the best outcome

  • Experience working in a CRM (such as Salesforce)

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

Senior Client Partner (Public Sector)
raw.description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Client Partner to join our Public Sector New Business Team for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex  challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from any of our UK offices (Dundee, Glasgow, Edinburgh and London)  2 days a week 

Are you a collaborative leader who excels at building meaningful relationships and shaping transformative digital solutions in the Public Sector? As our Senior Client Partner, you will play a key role in growing our Public Sector practice, acting as a trusted advisor to senior public sector stakeholders. You will work closely with our cross-functional teams to foster strategic partnerships, inspire creative proposals, and drive intelligent digital transformation that delivers real public value

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Creating Demand & Nurturing Relationships: Find, qualify, and develop opportunities with prospects and clients. Build and maintain trusted, peer-level relationships from delivery teams through to executive stakeholders.

  • Pitching & Proposals: Inspire and lead collaborative, cross-functional teams to win new business. Uncover client needs, articulate compelling win themes, and co-create high-impact proposals.

  • Planning & Pipeline Management: Develop systematic Account and Go-To-Market plans. Accurately forecast pipeline growth, extensions, and revenue alongside colleagues in delivery and finance.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Partner with tech, strategy, and delivery leaders to estimate and shape balanced commercial proposals. Negotiate long-term, win-win contracts that bring genuine value to both Waracle and our public sector partners.

  • Adding Strategic Value: Stay ahead of Public Sector and technology trends to bring valuable insights to clients, enhancing Waracle’s reputation as expert thought partners.

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box


What you'll bring

  • Proven track record of nurturing relationships and securing impactful work within central government departments or enterprise clients.

  • Strong relational skills, with an empathetic and collaborative approach to negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management in complex organisations.

  • Sound commercial stewardship and written/verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting ideas to executive and board-level audiences.

  • Strong understanding of Waracle's services, digital technology trends, and the Public Sector landscape.

  • Deep experience navigating public sector procurement frameworks (e.g., DOS6/7, GCloud 14/15, Tech Services 3/4, Public Contracts Scotland, Public Tender Scotland).

  • High level of integrity, empathy, and resilience, alongside enthusiasm for continuous learning and innovation.

  • Prior experience within the civil service or as a civil servant is welcomed, though not required.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

  • 3. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. This will be a practical presentation.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

raw.title: Account Executive
raw.description:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge

There are thousands of businesses globally growing fast and hitting the same wall - they need capital, and traditional lenders are too slow, too rigid, or simply not interested. We've already deployed over $6bn to growing businesses like these. The opportunity in front of us is significant, and we need people who can capitalise on it.

 

What you'll actually do

You'll own the full sales cycle from sourcing your own leads to closing deals with some of the most exciting consumer brands on the market. You'll run in-depth discovery calls using MEDDPICC, work closely with our underwriting team to move fast without cutting corners, and negotiate deals that genuinely work for both sides. You'll have a dedicated BDR alongside you, but you won't wait around for a full pipeline to land in your lap. The best AEs here source relentlessly, close confidently, and treat their customers like business partners, not transactions. Top performers are hitting ~200% of target. That's not a boast. It's a signal of what’s possible.

 

What this role could turn into

Account Executives at Wayflyer tend to grow in one of two directions - first on the ground in one of our emerging verticals, or into team leadership as we scale. We're continuing to launch new products and verticals, which means the people who perform here will have real options. We'd rather promote from within than hire from outside, and our track record reflects that.

 

Who thrives here
You've worked a full sales cycle before, and you didn't just hit your number; you understood exactly why you hit it and what to do differently when you didn't. You source your own pipeline without being asked, and you don't wait for perfect conditions to start. You're energised by ambiguity, not paralysed by it. You push deals forward when others would wait for a signal. When a sceptical founder pushes back, you lean in. You've been told "no" and come back with a better question. You care about eCommerce and small business growth, not as a line on a cover letter, but as a genuine reason you want this job.

We hire for range
Full sales cycle experience across a range of deal values (think: $10K to 100K) in SaaS or FinTech, ideally with time spent as an outbound BDR/SDR. You know what it takes to build a pipeline from scratch, not just work it. A consistent track record of exceeding targets matters more than tenure. Resilience shows up in your history: you've had a bad quarter, figured out why, and bounced back stronger. MEDDPICC familiarity is required. Startup or scale-up experience helps; the pace here is real, the playbook is still being written, and we need people who see that as an opportunity, not a risk.

 

Location and working policy

📍Dublin or London, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)

 

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.

raw.title: Talent Acquisition Partner, Generalist
raw.description:
HELP BUILD THE TEAMS SCALING CUTTING-EDGE CONSTRUCTION TECHNOLOGY


At XYZ Reality we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to help construction teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, we're looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to help build the business teams behind our next stage of growth, from HR, Finance and Legal to Marketing, Commercial and leadership roles.


THE ROLE

You'll own hiring across a broad range of business functions globally, partnering with leaders across HR, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Commercial, and supporting leadership hires as we grow. You'll work alongside our Talent Acquisition Partner - Technology as part of a small, high-impact TA team, reporting to our Head of Talent Acquisition.

This isn't a role focused on processing applications. You'll proactively find and engage the strongest people in the market, many of whom aren't actively looking, and advise hiring managers on what great looks like, where to find it and how to secure it.

No two weeks will look the same. One week you might be mapping the market for a senior Finance hire, the next closing a Marketing role in Europe or helping a leader shape a brand-new team.

The role is based in our London office, a 5-minute walk from Angel station, on a hybrid basis.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own end-to-end hiring for business roles globally (brief → offer → close), up to and including leadership positions

  • Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring plans, shape role profiles and challenge requirements where needed

  • Lead with direct sourcing, headhunting passive talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, networks, referrals and creative approaches

  • Run discreet, high-touch searches for senior and leadership hires

  • Manage hiring across multiple countries, navigating local markets, compensation and employment considerations

  • Lead offer negotiation and closing, advising on competitive packages

  • Coach hiring managers and interviewers on structured, inclusive assessment

  • Deliver a standout candidate experience from first touch to offer

  • Use data to improve hiring performance and processes, and reduce reliance on agencies

  • Provide market insight on salaries, talent trends and hiring strategy


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years' recruitment experience hiring across a broad range of business functions such as HR, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Commercial

  • Experience hiring senior and leadership roles

  • A strong direct sourcing track record. You go out and find great people rather than waiting for them to apply

  • Experience recruiting internationally across multiple countries

  • Strong stakeholder skills. You can challenge, influence and partner effectively with senior leaders

  • Comfortable managing a varied requisition load in a fast-paced, evolving environment, building process as you go

  • Familiarity with tools like Ashby ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter

Startup or scale-up experience, ideally at Series B or a similar stage, would be particularly valuable, as would in-house experience within a technology business or exposure to construction or construction technology.

Above all, we're looking for a recruiter who is proactive, commercially curious and energised by variety. Someone who enjoys partnering with leaders across the business and wants a genuine say in how we build our teams.


WHY JOIN US

🚀 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

🌍 Help build teams across the UK, US and Europe

🎯 Direct exposure to senior leadership and business-critical hires

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

🎄Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance (2–4 per year usually)

🚇 Office located within a 5-minute walk from Angel station

🏠 Hybrid working

🪙 Biannual salary reviews

🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

🍣 Free lunch bought in and after-work gathering/drinks every Thursday in the office

💰 Employee referral scheme

· 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

Ready to help us build the teams behind our next stage of growth? If you're an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner who loves variety, leads with direct sourcing and wants real impact in a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

If you'd like to see the products and technology we've created so far on our journey, you can view it in action through our YouTube and Website http://www.xyzreality.com/

raw.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.
