Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Junior Application Security Analyst in the Information Security team, you will help secure Checkout.com’s software applications throughout the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC). You will work closely with developers and product teams to integrate security early in the development process, identify and oversee the remediation of vulnerabilities, and ensure adherence to secure coding practices and application security standards. This role focuses on practical, hands-on security support while also growing your expertise in application security.

 

Key Responsibilities

SSDLC & Secure Coding

  • Assist in integrating security controls into the SSDLC.

  • Support the creation and maintenance of secure coding guidelines (e.g., OWASP Top 10, CERT Secure Coding Standards).

Application Security Testing

  • Run a Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) scans.

  • Conduct API security testing.

  • Support CI/CD pipelines to keep secure and effective integration.

Threat Modeling & Application Security Analysis

  • Participate in threat modeling sessions.

  • Document identified threats, assess risks and provide mitigation recommendations.

  • Assist in code and system reviews to analyse security in company’s products.

Vulnerability Management

  • Triage and prioritise vulnerabilities from automated scans.

  • Track, verify and ensure security flaws remediation.

  • Assist to automate an AppSec pipelines

Collaboration & Awareness

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate security into product design and improve existing systems.

  • Help deliver training and awareness on SSDLC best practices and secure coding.

  • Contribute to security documentations.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 1–3 years in application security, secure software development, or related IT/security role.

  • Understand basic network technologies and protocols (HTTP, TCP/IP, DNS and the OSI model).

  • Understanding of common software vulnerabilities and their mitigations.

  • Basic programming experience in a popular language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Golang).

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps principles.

  • Basic understanding of cloud technologies (AWS, GCP or Azure) and GitHub security features.

  • Strong attention to detail in documentation and assessments.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with SAST/DAST/SCA tools and API security testing platforms.

  • Exposure to cloud-native application security (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Understanding of container security (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience of participating in Capture The Flag (CTF) competitions.

Key Competencies

  • Eager to learn and expand technical skills in application security.

  • Effective communicator with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Collaborative and proactive problem solver.

  • Ability to prioritise work.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

As Director, SMB and Platforms Risk, you will own the first-line risk strategy and operating model for our SMB and platform sellers globally. You'll be based in London and report to the VP, Risk Operations. You will lead onboarding and monitoring teams in Mauritius and Mexico through local team leaders, and a BPO partner.

You will partner with Product, Risk Analytics, Engineering and Commercial to make onboarding and monitoring scalable, measurable and proportionate to risk. We're looking for a programmatic, systems-minded risk leader who can design the operating model and run it day to day, protecting the business while enabling responsible growth.

What You'll Do

  • Set the risk strategy and operating model across the seller lifecycle: onboarding, risk-based tiering, review criteria, monitoring triggers and actions such as reserves, funds controls and termination.

  • Partner with Product, Risk Analytics and Engineering to turn risk needs into clear requirements, decision logic and a prioritised automation roadmap.

  • Define and track the KPIs that balance control, customer experience and cost, including straight-through processing, onboarding time, loss rates and alert precision.

  • Lead operational performance across teams in Mauritius and Mexico through local leaders, setting priorities, procedures, SLAs, quality standards and capacity plans.

  • Scale the operation as headcount grows: stand up additional teams as needed, govern BPO partners, and prioritise automation improvements.

  • Close the loop between cases, losses and fraud patterns so that rules, thresholds, policy and product priorities keep improving.

  • Own first-line control quality and audit readiness, with clear handoffs of risks, issues and remediation to second-line oversight.

  • Represent SMB and Platforms Risk in governance, product and commercial forums, including risk-based pricing and bespoke platform deals. Hold a clear risk position while finding structured paths to yes.

  • Apply AI and LLM-enabled tools to triage, case summarisation, QA and risk insight, with appropriate human review, data protection and audit trails.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep risk expertise in SMB acquiring, with a strong grasp of credit exposure, reserves, fraud and transaction monitoring across the seller lifecycle.

  • Understanding of platform and PayFac models, including ISVs, marketplaces and merchant-of-record structures.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/KYB and CDD, and of how onboarding controls connect to downstream risk.

  • A programmatic mindset: you turn complex risk needs into operating models, requirements and roadmaps, make pragmatic trade-offs, and drive delivery.

  • Proven operational leadership of distributed teams through local leaders, with rigour in capacity planning, SLAs, QA, procedures and control evidence.

  • A track record of building or scaling automated onboarding and monitoring in a high-volume, low-touch environment.

  • Data fluency: you set meaningful KPIs, interpret rule and model performance, and work with analytics teams to improve outcomes.

  • Senior influence with Product, Commercial, Legal, Finance and executive audiences, with the confidence to challenge and find responsible ways to say yes.

  • Ability to travel to our Mauritius and Mexico offices at least twice a year.

Desirable

  • Hands-on depth in KYC/KYB, CDD and card-scheme requirements and controls.

  • Experience managing BPO or third-party operations partners, including performance governance and service-quality improvement.

  • Experience building a monitoring capability or operating model from the ground up in regulated payments or fintech.

  • Experience deploying AI-assisted operations or agentic workflows responsibly in risk, compliance or customer operations.

Additional Information

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Checkout.com is looking for an enthusiastic Engineer I to join the team responsible for Finance systems.

Your day-to-day focus will be on Workday Financials development and maintenance. You will have the opportunity to own other finance systems across checkout. This is a highly experienced role for someone already in a technical workday financials delivery role.

You'll partner closely with the Finance and Global Corporate Technology teams to keep critical core workday financials functions running smoothly

About the role

As an Engineer I, you will support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Workday Financials, with a focus on Record to Report (R2R). As Checkout has a complex finance architecture, you will be expected to also develop in learning our P2P system ZIP and Expenses system Emburse.

You will work with Finance and Technology stakeholders to understand requirements, configure and test solutions, investigate issues, and help maintain reliable financial processes and integrations. This is an early-career role for someone with 1–2 years of hands-on Workday Financials experience who is building technical and functional expertise.

What you will be doing

  • Support Workday Financials, ZIP and Emburse development, configuration, maintenance, and optimisation activities.

  • Contribute to Workday R2R processes, including core General Ledger, Financial Accounting, Close and Consolidation, Allocations, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Taxes, and Financial Reporting.

  • Help gather and clarify business requirements and translate them into practical Workday solutions.

  • Support configuration changes in Workday, following documented design, testing, and change-control practices.

  • Assist with triage and investigation of Workday integration failures, data discrepancies, and process issues.

  • Support financial data flows involving payroll, vendor master data, Accounts Payable in ZIP, and General Ledger postings.

  • Work with Finance stakeholders and technical teams to help deliver reliable, well-documented integrations.

  • Support Workday and ERP release cycles through impact analysis, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and change management.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, integration runbooks, configuration notes, and knowledge-base content.

  • Monitor recurring issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Research issues independently, document findings, and escalate problems when they exceed defined complexity or access boundaries.

  • Communicate progress, risks, issues, and proposed solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What you will bring

  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience supporting or delivering Workday Financials.

  • Understanding of core financial processes such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, period close, allocations, intercompany, or financial reporting.

  • Experience supporting Workday configuration, testing, incident resolution, or release activities.

  • A basic understanding of integrations, data flows, and data quality within enterprise applications.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate issues, identify likely root causes, and recommend next steps.

  • A structured and careful approach to configuration, testing, documentation, and change delivery.

  • The ability to understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into clear technical or functional actions.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-focused and collaborative approach.

  • A willingness to learn, develop Workday expertise, and research solutions independently.

Desirable experience

  • Experience with Workday Financials areas such as Financial Accounting, Close and Consolidation, Allocations, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Taxes, or Financial Reporting.

  • Accounting qualification and experience is desirable

  • Experience supporting payroll, vendor master, Accounts Payable, or General Ledger data flows.

  • Awareness of SOX, audit, data privacy, and control considerations in financial applications.

  • Experience working with Finance users, Technology teams, or implementation partners.

What success looks like

  • Workday Financials issues are investigated thoroughly and progressed with clear evidence.

  • Configuration and integration changes are tested, documented, and delivered in a controlled way.

  • Workday and finance tech processes and related data flows are supported reliably.

  • Requirements, decisions, and known issues are documented clearly.

  • Recurring problems are identified and converted into practical improvement opportunities.

  • You continue to build strong Workday Financials knowledge while contributing positively to the team.

Additional Information

The Role

Checkout.com holds licences in many countries, and the way we work with our supervisors matters more every year. We are creating a new Regulatory Affairs function to lead that work, and we are looking for the person to build it.

As Head of Regulatory Affairs, you will manage our supervisory relationships day to day and run the formal work that comes with them: information requests, thematic reviews, inspections and examinations. You will also shape how the new function works and where it grows, working closely with the Director of External Affairs.You will bring together the right people across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product and Tech, and make sure everything we send is accurate, consistent and on time.

You will start hands-on, building the foundations yourself, leveraging advanced AI tools, then build a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets over time.

What you'll do

Build the function

  • Shape our approach to supervisory engagement across our regulated entities.

  • Design how Regulatory Affairs works day to day, including how it works with Compliance, Legal, Risk and the business.

  • Help plan where the team grows, including which countries need local specialists and in what order.

  • Build a clear view of supervisory risk across the group and use it to set priorities.

  • Advise executives on what our supervisors expect and how upcoming supervisory activity will affect the business.

Manage our supervisory relationships

  • Run the regular cycle of supervisory meetings: preparation, briefing senior colleagues, attending and following up.

  • Keep a clear record of what we have told each regulator and what we have committed to.

  • Own the protocol for how we engage with supervisors, so colleagues know who speaks to whom and when.

  • Spot emerging issues early and raise them with senior leadership.

Run regulatory requests

  • Own regulator information requests and thematic reviews from receipt to submission: scope, owners, deadlines, evidence, version control and quality checks.

  • Act as a single front door for the business, so teams get one clear request instead of several.

  • Challenge draft responses for gaps and inconsistencies before they go out.

Lead inspections and examinations

  • Run inspections, examinations and skilled-person reviews as programmes, from the opening notice to the closing meeting.

  • Set the plan and the narrative, coordinate evidence, and prepare and rehearse subject-matter experts and senior leaders.

  • Run a lessons-learned review after each engagement and improve the process for next time.

Build the team and the infrastructure

  • Hire, develop and lead a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets.

  • Build the playbooks, templates, trackers and governance the function will run on.

  • Build a library of past submissions so we can reuse good work.

  • Set up regular reporting to senior leadership and entity boards on open requests, inspections and commitments.

What we are looking for

  • A builder. You have set up a function, team or process from scratch, and you enjoy turning an open brief into something that works.

  • Significant experience as a regulatory affairs manager / lead at a regulated payments, e-money or fintech firm.

  • Hands-on experience running regulatory information requests and inspections end to end, ideally across more than one country.

  • Time in a supervisory team at a major financial regulator, such as the FCA, ACPR, MAS or CBUAE, is a strong advantage.

  • Strategic judgement. You can set a clear direction, explain it to executives and turn it into a plan.

  • Excellent project management. You can run several deadlines with many contributors at once and keep every one of them on track.

  • A track record of keeping calm under pressure.

  • Sound judgement on when to bring in Legal or Compliance.

  • Credibility with regulators and the trust of senior executives.

  • Impeccable written communication.

  • People management experience, or clear readiness to build and lead a team

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role purpose

The Senior Analyst, Underwriting Quality Control (QC) will establish and continually improve a consistent, risk-based quality control framework for work completed by Underwriters. The role will build on existing QC practices and tools, tailoring them to the Underwriting lifecycle, products, risk decisions and operating model.

The role provides an objective, evidence-led check that underwriting assessments and outcomes are complete, consistent, appropriately documented and aligned with internal policy, procedures and applicable requirements. It will turn review results into clear management information, actionable feedback, targeted training and measurable improvements in underwriting quality.

This is a hands-on role. The Senior Analyst will conduct QC reviews, maintain the framework and reporting, follow findings through to verified remediation, and work with Underwriters and leaders to address recurring gaps. The role reports to the Director of Underwriting and influences quality across the function without replacing the Underwriter’s decision-making accountability.

Key responsibilities

Build and own the QC framework

  • Assess existing QC materials, controls, data and workflows; identify what should be retained, improved or introduced for Underwriting.

  • Design, document and implement an Underwriting-specific QC framework, including scope, risk-based sampling, review cadence, test scripts, scoring and severity definitions, evidence standards, escalation routes, dispute handling, calibration and remediation expectations.

  • Tailor testing to the relevant underwriting stages, products, merchant and business models, risk tiers and applicable regional requirements.

  • Define practical service levels and ownership for review, feedback, acknowledgement, remediation, re-review and closure, agreeing these with Underwriting leadership.

  • Establish appropriate governance and records so that QC decisions and remediation are traceable and ready for internal or external review.

Perform and calibrate QC reviews

  • Review completed underwriting cases and test whether the case record is complete, and appropriately documented. Depending on case scope, this may include business model products, services and geographies; ownership, control and beneficial ownership; company and identity evidence; KYC/KYB and screening outcomes; licences and regulatory status; financial and operational evidence and accurate system records.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent, stale or insufficient evidence, and opportunities to improve decision quality.

Drive remediation and constructive challenge

  • Communicate findings promptly, clearly and fairly to the relevant Underwriter and manager, with evidence and an actionable explanation of what needs to change.

  • Track acknowledgement, corrective action and deadlines; proactively chase overdue responses and escalate unresolved or repeat issues.

  • Work with Underwriters and leaders to understand root causes and ensure remediation addresses the underlying issue, not only the individual case.

Reporting, insight and continuous improvement

  • Produce regular, accurate QC reporting for Underwriting leadership, with clear commentary on coverage, pass and defect rates, severity, recurring themes, remediation status, turnaround and trends by relevant team, workflow, product or risk segment.

  • Support internal audit, Compliance, Risk and other assurance requests by providing accurate QC records and explaining methodology and outcomes.

Build underwriting capability

  • Identify capability gaps from QC findings and partner with Underwriting leaders and relevant subject-matter experts to design and deliver focused training, coaching and practical guidance.

What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate is a rigorous and constructive quality professional who can build a practical control framework, apply it consistently and influence experienced Underwriters. They combine sound KYC/KYB judgement with strong analytical and reporting skills, confidence in following through on remediation, and the ability to turn case-level observations into improvements across a regional operation.

Essential

  • Significant experience in underwriting, merchant due diligence, AML/KYC/KYB, onboarding, financial crime operations, quality control, quality assurance or a related risk function within financial services, payments or fintech.

  • Practical understanding of UK and EEA due diligence requirements, with familiarity across the US, Canada, Singapore, Hong Kong, UAE, Australia and New Zealand; ability to recognise jurisdictional differences and escalate interpretation questions appropriately.

  • Demonstrated ability to design, implement or materially improve a QC, QA, control testing or file review framework.

  • Strong reporting and data skills, including spreadsheets, pivot tables and clear management reporting; experience with Looker dashboard or business intelligence tools is an advantage. Use of AI is a plus.

  • Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the persistence to chase remediation and escalate overdue or repeat issues appropriately.

  • Experience delivering training or coaching based on quality control findings.

Nice to Have

  • Direct exposure to underwriting or due diligence in a merchant acquiring setting.

  • Familiarity with case management and CRM tools,dashboard platforms.

  • A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; recognised AML, financial crime or compliance qualifications (for example ACAMS or ICA) are beneficial but not mandatory.

Additional Information

What We’re Building

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer and B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Canva use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

The Role

As Talent Partner at Conveo, you will build the team that builds the company. You'll join a small, lean talent team and play a big part in how we scale. You'll play a key part in how Conveo attracts, assesses, and ultimately hires talent across the US, UK, and Belgium, helping us scale past 100 people and deliver our 2027 hiring plan.

You'll close exceptional talent across engineering, product, go-to-market, and operations, while contributing to hiring strategy and talent decisions. You won't be limited to one area. You'll work with stakeholders and leadership across departments. If your experience leans towards one area, such as product and engineering, go-to-market, or operations, that's fine. We're open to candidates with a variety of backgrounds.

This isn't a transactional recruiting role. You'll shape how candidates experience Conveo and help build a team with high talent density for the long term. Proactive sourcing and strong execution will be central to your success.

Talent operations plays a small part in this role. Lots of foundations are already in place, and you'll help build on them as we scale. If you like to experiment and work with the latest tech, especially AI, you'll find this role really interesting.

We're growing fast, so priorities shift and you'll often make calls with imperfect information.

What You’ll Do

Own hiring outcomes end-to-end

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and leadership

  • Own roles from kickoff to close, including sourcing and closing

  • Maintain speed without sacrificing quality

  • Develop strong hiring judgment

Build proactive talent pipelines

  • Develop centralised talent pipelines across key disciplines, enabling the business to take a broader and more proactive approach to hiring

  • Create innovative sourcing strategies for particular searches, incorporating AI-enabled sourcing, targeted outbound campaigns, market mapping, events, and external communities

  • Proactively source top-tier talent using LinkedIn, Juicebox, and other tools. Our toolkit isn't fixed. We're always looking at new tools, and deciding whether to build them internally or use them externally, to level up our sourcing and recruitment capabilities.

  • Provide external talent intelligence, including candidate availability, competitor activity, compensation, and wider market trends

Build a high-signal candidate experience

  • Be the main point of contact and advocate for candidates

  • Every candidate hears back from us quickly, whether it's a yes or a no.

  • Pitch Conveo with real conviction, because you understand the product, the market and why people join.

  • Contribute to employer branding content that shows what it's like to work at Conveo

  • Support events that put Conveo in front of top talent

  • Improve interview loops, scorecards, and decision-making

  • Build repeatable playbooks and templates

  • Ownership of our hiring goals: you understand the hiring plan and your contribution to it. When blockers come up, you flag them and proactively work to fix them so we hit our goals.

  • Gaps found and closed: you work autonomously, but take time early on to understand what gaps exist and why, then work with the team to close them.

  • Better decisions over time: you make decisions in the moment with the best information available, even when the data isn't perfect, and push to gather more data so future decisions are better informed.

  • A better way of doing things: you challenge the status quo when something could be done in a way that's better for the business, drawing on your experience and backing it up with data and resources.

  • Strong execution and high ownership: you run several roles and priorities at once, keep every process moving without dropped steps, and follow through on what you commit to

  • A good understanding of recruitment analytics and the ability to use data to influence hiring strategy and improve performance

  • Practical experience using AI and modern recruitment technology to improve sourcing, personalisation, market intelligence, and recruitment efficiency

  • Experience partnering closely with senior leaders, and the ability to build credibility with highly senior stakeholders

  • A builder mentality and a genuine interest in tech, AI, and the startup community. You enjoy identifying problems, improving processes, and creating better ways of working rather than simply operating within an existing recruitment model.

Why Join Us?

  • Build the team for a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company

  • Work directly with founders and strong operators. At our size, every hire you make visibly shapes the company.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Based in our London office 3 days a week. We also have offices in Antwerp and New York.

  • Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more

  • Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to: Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal

  • Private health coverage with Vitality (incl. dental, vision)

  • Enhanced employer pension contribution (5% employer, 3% employee contribution)

  • Refer someone great and earn up to £5,000

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

World-class customer service is one of the cornerstones. We're about delivering exceptional customer experiences and are looking for someone who understands the power of outstanding support. Someone who thrives on leading an engineering team to excellence and who believes in the importance of effective communication.

Imagine being at the helm of a team dedicated to ensuring every customer interaction is a delight. As an Engineering Manager in this team, you'll have the opportunity to lead a diverse team of engineers who are passionate about building top-notch support products and tools. With your guidance, they'll be empowered to tackle challenges head-on and build a high-load real-time system, crucial to continue supporting the growth of our business.
Location: London, UK. This is a hybrid role, with 3 days a week in the office.

About the Role

You'll be the driving force behind our support operations, leading a cross-functional team across backend, web, and mobile development. Fostering their growth, and ensuring they have the support they need to thrive. Your days will be filled with collaboration, mentorship, and strategic planning as you lead your team through the weekly cycle, create personal development plans, and conduct regular one-on-ones.

But it's not just about leading a team; it's about making an impact. You'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our customer support, working closely with our Product Lead to develop new innovative solutions. And with over 25+ million monthly users counting on us, your contributions will directly impact the experiences of millions around the world.
Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • To thrive in our team, you'll need solid leadership experience collaborating strongly with product teams and business stakeholders.
  • Being flexible and comfortable working with various languages and technologies depending on the task is a big plus.
  • Previous hands-on software development experience in backend is definitely needed.
  • You happen to be a big adept of modern AI tools and stay close to the code.
  • We appreciate candidates who have worked closely with product teams and senior team members, and who can handle stakeholder relationships on the business side.
  • Experience with rollouts and fast-paced production environments is essential.
  • Additionally, having expertise in Kubernetes and AWS would be valuable, as we rely on these technologies for our projects.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

#LI-LW1

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

raw.title: Senior Marketing Manager, Commercial Marketing (Grocery & Retail)
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

Deliveroo connects millions of consumers with the restaurants and brands they love. Our Integrated Marketing team sits at the heart of how we bring those relationships to life — combining customer insight, commercial opportunity and creativity to drive growth for Deliveroo and our partners.

Within Central Integrated Marketing, the Merchant & Ads team sets the global strategy for how we partner with merchants to help them grow on our marketplace and create compelling reasons for consumers to choose Deliveroo. This is an opportunity to shape Deliveroo's global approach to merchant partnerships, building high-impact collaborations with some of the world's most recognised and loved brands. This will be a hybrid role - working 3 days a week from our London HQ. 

About the role

  • Owns the New Verticals merchant and ads marketing strategy end to end, reporting into the Merchant & Ads Integrated Marketing Director.

  • Responsible for the creation and deployment of New Verticals merchant marketing playbooks across co marketing, promotions, and ads.

  • Responsible for the creation and deployment of the New Verticals sell in strategy and associated sell in materials for adoption by local teams.

  • Supports local marketing teams with key enterprise merchant relationships at the global level, and supports local New Verticals marketing initiatives.

What you'll be doing

Ads & Monetization Strategy

  • Own the New Verticals specific ads and monetization strategy across owned and external surfaces, feeding into the global monetization strategy.

  • Lead pricing, packaging, and investment decisions for merchant advertising in your category, in partnership with Commercial and Finance.

Category Playbook: New Verticals

  • Own and evolve the New Verticals merchant marketing playbook, setting how co marketing, promotions, and advertising work for grocery and retail merchants globally.

  • Lead change initiatives that improve how New Verticals merchant marketing works, bringing Local Integrated Marketing and Functional Marketing along with you.

Key Merchant Relationship Management

  • Support local marketing teams with key enterprise merchant relationships at the global level, and support delivery of priority New Verticals marketing initiatives with those merchants.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for merchant issues that cross multiple markets or functions.

Cross Functional Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to Merchant S&O and Commercial for New Verticals, translating category priorities into marketing and ads strategy.

  • Represent New Verticals in cross functional forums, shaping the roadmap for merchant facing and ads facing surfaces.

Sell In Strategy & Sales Enablement

  • Own the sell-in strategy for New Verticals merchant and ads programmes, defining how Commercial and Local teams pitch these programmes to merchants.

  • Oversee the sell in materials, case studies, and proof points for New Verticals, using performance data to continuously refine them.

Central Strategy & Market Coordination

  • Own delivery of the New Verticals merchant marketing goals, coordinating a consistent strategy across all Deliveroo markets.

  • Report on New Verticals merchant and ads marketing performance to senior stakeholders, own specific business metrics, and lead course correction when needed.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of marketing experience, ideally including merchant marketing, retail media, ads, or category marketing in a consumer or marketplace business.

  • Track record of owning the marketing strategy for an entire team or category, and resolving complex delivery challenges that span multiple teams or functions.

  • Experience managing people, and comfortable managing other people managers as your team grows.

  • Strong commercial acumen, seen as a go to expert for merchant or ads marketing, using business and financial data to make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.

  • Confident communicator, able to present complex ideas to large groups and flex your style for directors and department leadership.

  • Skilled at establishing and owning cross functional partnerships, using relationships and creative thinking to work through conflict.

  • Proven ability to lead change initiatives that improve how a team or category works, bringing others along with you.

About the Role

We're hiring an engineer for the Storefront team to build the digital experiences behind merchants' own branded websites and apps. This is an opportunity to work on highly visible, customer-facing products while solving meaningful platform challenges.

 

What you'll do?

As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals in and across your team. While you will work with your team and you may lead projects, some of your work will contribute outside of your direct remit. You will report to managers and group leads and together deliver the results.

Technical Execution:

  • You will improve code structure, have an impact on architecture, and review code of any scope produced by your team.
  • You'll aim to simplify the maintenance and operation of production systems, visibility, operational readiness, and health of your team's systems.

Collaboration & Leadership:

  • As well as leading from the front regarding technical execution, you'll build relationships with other engineering teams and, identify collaboration opportunities.
  • You'll own larger pieces of work, assist with design and technical / implementation choices and influence the roadmap within your team.
  • You will take an active role in the hiring process and conducting engineering interviews. This will also extend to the current team where you will support the personal growth of colleagues, encouraging efficiency in their roles.

Expectations:

We want to emphasise that we don't expect you to meet all of the below but would love you to have experience in some of these areas.

  • Pride in readable, well-designed, well-tested software
  • Experience with Go and/or Python 
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Experience with web architecture at scale (20krpm and above)
  •   Experience with "NoSQL" data backends and other (Redis, DynamoDB, ElasticSearch, Memcache)
  • Experience solving logistical problems with software

raw.title: Software Engineer II - Code Context
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Software Engineer

Location: London, UK

Join Code Context, a team helping to shape the future of AI-powered work at Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt. You'll solve challenging technical problems and build tools that help employees work smarter, move faster, and deliver better outcomes across a global business serving millions of customers, riders, and partners.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll join an engineering-led team focused on a fundamental challenge in AI-assisted software development: giving coding agents the right context to work effectively. As a Software Engineer on the Code Context team, you'll build developer tooling and infrastructure that connects AI agents with the knowledge, systems, and workflows they need. Your work will help every employee across Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt make better use of AI in their day-to-day work.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Build Developer Tooling: Design, build, and maintain the infrastructure and tooling that make relevant context accessible to AI coding agents across complex codebases and workflows.
  • Own Technical Projects: Independently take technical projects from design through delivery and adoption, evaluating approaches, making sound technical decisions, and measuring their impact. Contribute to the team's technical direction in a fast-moving AI landscape.
  • Build for Reliability & Scale: Ensure the systems behind our developer tooling remain reliable, performant, and secure as adoption grows. Use observability, feedback, and real-world usage to identify issues and continuously improve the developer experience.
  • Collaborate & Influence: Work closely with engineering teams and stakeholders across Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt to understand their challenges, identify opportunities, and drive adoption of AI-powered tooling.
  • Support Peers & Grow: Share technical knowledge, provide constructive feedback, help unblock colleagues, and contribute to engineering interviews and hiring as the team grows.

raw.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 1 day in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

We're looking for a Copywriter to join our Brand team for three days a week.

You'll take ownership of much of our campaign copywriting, reviewing, refining and sharpening copy so it's clear, persuasive and unmistakably Funding Circle. You'll work across brand and product campaigns targeting small businesses, on channels including email, web, digital, print, direct, audio, and organic social.

You'll need to be a self-starter who's comfortable working with a range of stakeholders, giving and receiving feedback, and turning things around quickly. You'll pick up our tone of voice as if it's your own and know instinctively when copy reads right and when it needs another pass.

  • Producing highly converting product copy and content for the website and cross-channel campaigns, working closely with the brand and design teams

  • Editing and refining campaign copy from across the team to ensure it's on-brand, consistent and conversion-focused

  • Copywriting for our Premiership Rugby partnership, including campaign headlines and digital ads

  • Helping teams across the business to deliver on-brand communications

  • Support the brand team on campaigns, events and other projects to grow the brand

  • Proactively spotting and flagging risks or issues, such as compliance-sensitive wording in a regulated industry

 

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • 3+ years experience in a copy focused role

  • Experience writing marketing copy for email marketing, direct mail, social and blogs, and experience writing for website conversion a bonus

  • Excellent writing skills shown in a portfolio of work

  • Ability to follow brand guidelines and deliver tone of voice across all comms

  • Experience of working with multiple stakeholders and incorporating feedback

  • Previous experience in financial services or another regulated sector is preferred

  • Experience writing for businesses (B2B marketing) or SMEs would be a bonus

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

Internal Communications Manager - 12 month FTC
raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

Full-time, temporary position for approximately 12 months, based in Stockholm or London

The Role

We’re looking for an Internal Communications Manager to strengthen the communication that keeps Legora aligned, informed, and moving quickly as we scale globally.

Over approximately 12 months, you’ll take ownership of our internal communications strategy, channels, and cadence. You’ll turn complex information into clear, useful communication, and help translate company priorities into shared understanding and action.

Reporting to the Senior Communications Director EMEA, you’ll work closely with the leadership team, Head of Operations, VP Marketing, and teams across Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, and People. Your focus will be making sure decisions land well, context is shared at the right time, and our culture remains strong as we grow.

Your Mandate

Create clarity, alignment, and momentum across a fast-moving organization—with as little friction and noise as possible.

What You’ll Do

Internal Communications Strategy & Operating Rhythm

  • Execute the internal communications strategy: audiences, messages, channels, and tone.

  • Manage a scalable comms operating rhythm (weekly updates, leadership notes, All-Hands/Townhalls, Q&A formats).

  • Ensure the right information reaches the right people at the right time — without noise.

Leadership & Change Communications

  • Partner with leadership to shape narratives and craft clear updates on priorities, decisions, and progress.

  • Lead communications for organizational change: new processes, policy changes, major launches.

  • Build trust through transparency and consistency, especially during ambiguity.

Improve Channels, Content & Knowledge Flow

  • Own and continuously improve internal communications channels (e.g., Slack, Notion)

  • Produce crisp, useful content: announcements, FAQs, decision summaries, “what changed” notes, playbooks.

  • Create templates and standards that help teams communicate clearly and consistently.

Strengthen Culture and Engagement

  • Capture and amplify what matters: wins, learnings, customer impact, and how we work.

  • Strengthen culture and collaboration across teams and geographies through thoughtful storytelling and rituals.

  • Track engagement and effectiveness, then iterate based on what people actually need.

Who You Are

You’re driven by clarity, pace, and simplicity. You are an excellent listener, and you love taking messy inputs and making them easy to understand without losing nuance.

You thrive in fast-changing environments, bring structure where it’s needed, and have strong judgment on what to communicate, when, and how.

You Are

  • A sharp, confident writer who is equally strong in short-form (Slack) and long-form (narratives, memos).

  • Highly proactive and independent, with excellent prioritization.

  • Comfortable working closely with leadership.

  • Curious about AI and excited to use tools to communicate smarter (not louder).

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in internal communications, corporate communications or similar roles in high-growth environments.

  • Proven ability to run internal comms across a cross-functional organization.

  • Strong project management skills and a process-oriented mindset.

  • Excellent English communication skills.

  • Familiarity with tools like Slack/Notion/Google Workspace; comfort building systems that scale.

Why This Role Matters

Legora is growing quickly. During this next phase, strong internal communication will be essential to keeping teams focused, connected, and moving in the same direction.

Although this is a temporary position, the impact will be lasting. You’ll strengthen the foundations for clear communication and help an exceptional global team continue operating with speed, focus, and precision.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

Legal AI is inventing its best practices in real time, and this role sits where that happens. You'll sit within the Legal Engineering team and work hand in hand with Product at one of the fastest-growing legal AI companies in the world, seeing new capabilities before almost anyone else, experimenting with them against real legal work, and turning what you learn into the standards a global function runs on. In a year here, you will see and vet more legal AI use cases than most people in the industry see in a career, working directly with some of the best legal engineers in the industry.

This is a judgement role, not a filing one. You'll be the person who vets the skills, workflows and use cases the function ships: testing them hands-on, separating the genuinely strong from the merely plausible, and quality-controlling practice-area workflows so that what carries the Legora name is consistently excellent. You'll research and experiment with prompting techniques and applied AI methods, author the exemplar use cases the rest of the function copies, and teach what you learn: delivering technical onboarding for new Legal Engineers in your region and broadcasting best practices to the team worldwide. And because judgement needs grounding, around 30% of your time stays on live client work, chosen for what it teaches.

Specifically, you will

• Vet the Skills Library and Legal Engineering outputs against the quality bar: review skills, workflows and use cases hands-on before they go live, and quality-control practice-area workflows for consistency.

• Research and experiment with prompting techniques, skill patterns and emerging AI methods, and turn what works into best practices the whole function adopts.

• Author the reference use cases that show what great looks like, published as the exemplars others copy.

• Work closely with the Product team on up-and-coming capabilities: early hands-on testing, the first best practices for new features, and structured feedback from real use.

• Produce materials that would support the technical onboarding and training for new Legal Engineers in your region, such as best practices to create use cases etc.

• Communicate new best practices, exemplars and platform changes to the Legal Engineering team worldwide.

• Support the flagship demos our CEO and C-suite take on stage at the industry’s biggest events: use case preparation, fixtures and rehearsal support.

• Oversee the quality and currency of the use case and skills libraries, including coordination across regions

• Spend roughly 30% of your time on live client work, selected for what it feeds back into the standards and libraries.

What you bring

You're a lawyer with real practice experience who has become genuinely technical: maybe you did a coding bootcamp, maybe you taught yourself, but either way you're the person colleagues ask how something actually works. You live in AI tools, and it shows: you can tell a strong use case from a plausible-sounding weak one, you know why a prompt underperforms before you've finished reading it, and you hold both halves of the judgement this role needs: what makes a prompt run well, and what makes a legal output substantively right rather than merely fluent. When you vet, you vet properly: line by line against the source, with the discipline to put the AI down when the job calls for your own eyes.

We're looking for

• A qualified lawyer with solid practice experience at a leading firm or in-house team, or equivalent: enough substantive judgement to vet outputs across practice areas.

• Real technical prowess: comfortable with code or scripting (a bootcamp or self-taught background counts entirely), and fluent in the mechanics of how AI tools actually behave.

• A heavy, habitual user of AI, ideally legal AI, with sharp prompt and use case discernment: able to rank a strong prompt against a mediocre one, articulate exactly why, and improve it.

• Visible pride in the craft of prompting and use case design: someone who wants to be the reference point for what good looks like.

• Rigour in review: line-by-line verification against source, and the judgement to know exactly when not to use AI.

• Comfortable running high-throughput workstreams: you triage well, keep many threads moving, and build process where volume demands it.

• Experience building skills, workflows or automations in a legal AI platform is a strong plus.

• Good to have: an M&A or wider transactional background, or deal coordination experience.

Where this role can go

This role is built to grow with the field itself. Applied legal AI knowledge barely exists as a discipline yet, and nobody accumulates evidence faster than the person vetting and testing the entire output of a global function. Do this job well and you are positioned to become one of the industry’s recognised voices on what good looks like. Inside Legora, the role is designed to grow into owning applied AI knowledge globally: the standards, techniques and systems every region operates on. Growth is subject to performance and company need, but the direction is deliberate: master the material here first, then define the standard for the industry.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across our most important global accounts, developing a deep understanding of their priorities, challenges and ambitions.

raw.description:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

 

About The Role

As a Senior Pricing Strategy Manager, you will play a key role in shaping and executing our pricing & packaging strategy to drive sustainable growth, maximize customer value, and optimize revenue. You will combine strategic thinking with operational excellence, partnering with cross-functional teams to develop, implement, and continuously improve pricing initiatives across the organization.

 

This is a highly strategic cross-functional role that works closely with Leadership, Product, Sales, Finance, Billing, and Analytics to develop and translate pricing strategies into scalable business outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and evolve the company's pricing and packaging strategy in the era of AI, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer value, and shifting market trends and positioning.

  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to identify pricing opportunities and validate strategic decision making with our executives.

  • Build business cases, pricing models, demand forecasts, and revenue impact analyses to support pricing recommendations, with our analyst team.

  • Support end-to-end implementation of new pricing models, offerings, packages, and pricing changes across internal systems and business processes, with our operations team.

  • Drive operational excellence by improving pricing governance, approval processes, discount policies, and implementation workflows.

  • Continuously evaluate pricing performance, customer behavior, and market dynamics to optimize revenue, profitability, and customer adoption.

  • Foster strong partnerships across the organization to align stakeholders around pricing strategy and execution.

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Pricing Strategy, Growth & Monetization, Strategic / Management Consulting or similar strategic business roles.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS companies or similar business and pricing models.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

  • Proven experience leading cross-functional teams from strategy through execution.

  • Strong business acumen, with experience in building analysis based business case.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to influence teams across all levels of the organization.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Proactive, curious, and hands-on problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with pricing and packaging strategy.

  • Background in strategy consulting and working with c-suite executives.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Finance, or other quantitative fields.

  • Experience working with billing, monetization, or revenue systems.

  • Experience leading or mentoring analysts or cross-functional operation teams.

What monday.com can offer you:

  • Join a customer-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate - not just things we put on a wall

  • Work on a multi-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide

  • Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success

  • Grow fast through a dedicated L&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons - the industry moves quick and so do we

raw.title: Senior TechOps Generalist
raw.description:
Seen this advert before? That is because we are continuing to grow!

 

We are very excited to be growing our small and efficient TechOps team at Octopus. We aren't looking for standard IT support - we are looking for an ambitious, deeply knowledgeable and experienced TechOps Generalist to join our team, to grow with the rest of the company, and ensure we are doing so in a secure and safe way.

You will be a key partner in defining what TechOps is at Octopus. We will be continuing to shape this team to provide world class support to our employees, building our way out of problems with engineering firepower and undertaking transformational organisational change. We don't just "fix" things - we automate them out of existence.

For us, a Generalist isn’t about knowing a little of everything, it’s a multi-disciplinary role for someone who’s deeply experienced in many facets of Enterprise IT. Think multi-domain specialist - not Jack of all trades.

What is TechOps?
A more modern, more lean version of a traditional enterprise IT team. We cover everything from what most people would call “1st line support” all the way up to high-level strategic planning, and everything in between.

We focus on advising rather than enforcing, and give people the autonomy to work with technology to solve their problems in the way that works best for them. We’re an autonomous team who look after a wide range of technology across the business. We empower teams to do the best work they can whilst keeping things running efficiently in the background.

We tackle big problems and the breadth of work is huge. Dealing with ambiguity is a key part of working in TechOps, and every day will be a new and exciting one, working on varying challenges across the company.

We have a cloud-first approach to everything we do. This allows us to scale quickly and focus on things where we can add the most value. No on-prem AD here!

 


What you'll do
  • Provide delightful day-to-day technical support to all areas of the business, to ensure our incredible employees are able to do their job as efficiently as possible. Their problems are our problems.
  • Troubleshoot and fix a wide range of technical issues, from laptop faults and network issues, to account provisioning failures and SSO problems.
  • Collaborate closely with our Security team to ensure we strike the right balance between security, productivity and user experience.
  • Continually find opportunities to automate our processes and improve the user experience.
  • Empower our people to help themselves by designing and building self-service solutions.
  • Monitor and maintain all the tech in our offices around the world - networks, meeting rooms, printers, digital signage, CCTV, door access control.
  • Managing supplier relationships and the procurement process for SaaS and hardware.
  • Lead and manage complex technical projects with multiple stakeholders from around the business. 
    •  
    Examples of some TechOps projects include…
  • Rollout of, and migration to, a new identity provider
  • macOS and Windows MDM migration
  • Rollout of a new device trust and posture compliance solution
  • The replacement of insecure factors like SMS with phishing-resistant factors
  • Office fit-outs, including tech like network, AV, access control etc
  • SaaS migrations for acquisitions e.g. Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace

    • What you'll need

    We’re looking for people with at least 5-7 years of solid enterprise IT experience.

    The technical bar is high. While we use Okta, Kandji, Kolide, Zscaler, Meraki and HiBob amongst others, we care about your understanding of the fundamentals of key SaaS tooling, but we also expect candidates to have significant experience implementing and customising these tools for Enterprise environments, so if you’ve lived in Entra and Intune? Awesome!

    You’ll also need:

  • Confidence in articulating and implementing your technical ability, particularly with enterprise-level SaaS tooling, customer support and automation. The ability to do this both with your peers and novice users is vital.
  • A team player - we don’t want people who vanish and come back with perfect, completed work. You collaborate and work transparently and can identify who can help you, or needs your help.
  • Rich experience and examples of scripting, using APIs to automating mundane and error-prone repetitive tasks.
  • To be comfortable with a huge amount of ambiguity and spinning a lot of plates all at the same time.
  • Experience working with multiple teams and managing multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience managing and deploying macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android at scale
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies such as OAuth, OIDC and SAML.
  • Deep experience with Identity & Access Management. You should be able to explain the nuances of SAML, OIDC, and OAuth, and have hands-on experience with SCIM provisioning.
  • Experience of designing and installing office networks - we use Cisco Meraki.
  • A conscientious approach to everything you do and a passion for doing the right thing rather than the easy thing.

    • Don’t think you check off every single box? We love hiring passionate people with a drive to learn. If you are an expert in some of these areas and are hungry to master the rest, get in touch and let us know where your strengths lie.


    Why else you'll love it here
  • Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We won best company to work for in 2022, on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022 and our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
  •  Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
    •  
     
    This role can be either fully office based in any of our major offices in Brighton, Manchester, Leicester, Coventry or London, or a hybrid of a few days a week working remotely and office based. 
     
     
    Our salary bandings are between £65,000 - £90,000 depending on your experience. On a call with one of our talent team, it's something we always chat through, as we genuinely want to match your experience with the right salary.
     
     
    We're very excited to be growing our small team. We're looking for skills and experience to help shape and define the future of not only our team, but the wider business at a global scale. If you're reading this and grinning, please apply! There are huge challenges to tackle, and we need amazing people who are keen to get stuck in.
     
    If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you.
     
    Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
     
    Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

  • Provide delightful day-to-day technical support to all areas of the business, to ensure our incredible employees are able to do their job as efficiently as possible. Their problems are our problems.

raw.title: Account Director
raw.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Account Director (6 Month FTC)

Location: London/ Slough, United Kingdom  (2-3 days a week from our Client's Slough Offices)

About the role: 

 

As Account Director, working within our client, & global FMCG business; you are the trusted day-to-day partner for client and the person who keeps complex, multi-platform projects on track. You'll work closely with strategy, creative, production and account colleagues to turn briefs into effective campaigns, with a strong focus on social media and digital content. You'll be accountable for delivery, client satisfaction and project profitability across several projects at once.

What you will be doing: 

  • Build a collaborative, trusted relationship with client stakeholders, acting as their first point of contact and protecting the brand across every project.
  • Stay close to the client to understand their needs, anticipate issues and resolve them early.
  • Be accountable for integrated creative projects from brief to fulfilment, maintaining client satisfaction throughout.
  • Work with strategy and account colleagues to shape social strategy and milestones for the client.
  • Agree campaign scope with the client, then produce estimates and timing plans in our internal scheduling system, including for complex, cross-platform social projects.
  • Schedule projects against the right internal resource and help source external resource where needed.
  • Partner with digital, video, photography and print producers to bring the right skills together for integrated campaigns.
  • Keep projects on process, on time and on budget, motivating and coordinating teams through tight deadlines.
  • Be responsible for the financial health of your projects, including profitability, forecasting accuracy and fee discussions. Make sure everyone understands the cost impact of delays, extra amends and re-briefs.
  • Report on project income accurately and on time, and escalate invoicing or estimate queries to senior account and business leadership.
  • Evaluate project results, both qualitative and quantitative, against the original objectives.
  • Guide internal stakeholders through production processes, and spot and act on ad hoc opportunities as they arise.

 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Experience managing digital and integrated campaigns in a creative or production agency, with a strong record of delivering across multiple platforms, particularly social media.
  • Ideally FMCG experience
  • Proficient to expert capability in Account Management and Project Management, with confidence running several complex projects at once.
  • Experience working alongside video and photography producers as part of a joined-up approach to campaign delivery.
  • Experience with project scheduling and sourcing resource and production services.
  • Strong client engagement skills, with the ability to organise, influence and build effective working relationships.
  • Clear, courteous communication across strategy, creative, production and client teams.
  • Close attention to detail, sound commercial awareness and a sharp eye for project risk.
  • Comfort integrating with a client-side team while maintaining a top-tier agency service.
  • Nice to have: experience creating content for CMS and e-commerce platforms.
  • Advanced use of Gen AI tools relevant to account management to improve output quality and efficiency
  • Experience designing AI-assisted workflows for yourself and your team
  • Agentic thinking for complex, multi-step challenges
  • Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, with rigorous human oversight

We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.
